source.text: Γνωρίζω δὲ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ὃ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν, ὃ καὶ παρελάβετε, ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἑστήκατε, δι’ οὗ καὶ σῴζεσθε, τίνι λόγῳ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν, εἰ κατέχετε, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ εἰκῇ ἐπιστεύσατε.

records.literal_gloss: I make known but to you, brothers, the gospel which I proclaimed to you, which also you received, in which also you stand, \v 2 through which also you are being saved, with what word I proclaimed [it] to you, if you hold fast, unless in vain you believed.

en.L: Now I make known to you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, the gospel that I proclaimed to you, which you also received, in which you also stand, \v 2 through which you are also being saved, with what message I proclaimed [it] to you, if you are holding [it] fast, unless you believed in vain.
en.B: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I am setting out for you once more the gospel I proclaimed to you. You received it, you stand firm in it, \v 2 and through it you are being saved, if you keep hold of the message as I proclaimed it to you. Otherwise you came to believe for nothing.
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, let me remind you of the good news I told you. You accepted it, and you are standing firm in it. \v 2 Through it God is saving you, as long as you hold on to the message just as I told it to you. If you do not, your believing was for nothing.

fr.L: Or je vous fais connaître, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, l’Évangile que je vous ai annoncé, que vous avez aussi reçu, dans lequel aussi vous tenez ferme, \v 2 par lequel aussi vous êtes sauvés, en quels termes je vous [l’]ai annoncé, si vous [le] retenez, à moins que vous n’ayez cru pour rien.
fr.B: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je vous expose une fois encore l’Évangile que je vous ai annoncé. Vous l’avez reçu, vous y tenez ferme, \v 2 et par lui vous êtes en train d’être sauvés, si vous gardez le message tel que je vous l’ai annoncé. Sinon, vous avez cru pour rien.
fr.R: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je veux vous rappeler la bonne nouvelle que je vous ai annoncée. Vous l’avez acceptée, et vous tenez ferme en elle. \v 2 Par elle, Dieu est en train de vous sauver, à condition que vous restiez attachés au message tel que je vous l’ai annoncé. Sinon, vous avez cru pour rien.

es.L: Ahora bien, {{plural_you:les|os}} hago saber, hermanos, el evangelio que {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncié, que también {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}}, en el cual también {{plural_you:están firmes|estáis firmes}}, \v 2 por medio del cual también {{plural_you:están siendo salvados|estáis siendo salvados}}, con qué palabra {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncié [el evangelio], si [lo] {{plural_you:retienen|retenéis}}, a no ser que {{plural_you:hayan creído|hayáis creído}} en vano.
es.B: Hermanos, quiero {{plural_you:recordarles|recordaros}} el evangelio que {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncié. {{plural_you:Ustedes lo recibieron|Vosotros lo recibisteis}} y en él {{plural_you:se mantienen|os mantenéis}} firmes, \v 2 y por medio de él {{plural_you:están siendo salvados|estáis siendo salvados}}, si {{plural_you:se aferran|os aferráis}} al mensaje tal como yo {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} anuncié. De lo contrario, {{plural_you:habrán|habréis}} creído en vano.
es.R: Hermanos, quiero {{plural_you:recordarles|recordaros}} la buena noticia que {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncié. {{plural_you:Ustedes la aceptaron|Vosotros la aceptasteis}} y {{plural_you:se mantienen|os mantenéis}} firmes en ella. \v 2 Por medio de ella Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} está salvando, siempre que {{plural_you:se aferren|os aferréis}} al mensaje tal como yo {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} anuncié. Si no lo {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}, {{plural_you:habrán|habréis}} creído para nada.

sw.L: Basi nawajulisha, ndugu, Injili niliyowahubiria, ambayo pia mliipokea, ambayo pia mmesimama ndani yake, \v 2 ambayo kupitia hiyo pia mnaokolewa, ikiwa mnalishika kwa uthabiti neno lile nililowahubiria, isipokuwa mliamini bure.
sw.B: Ndugu, nataka kuwaeleza tena Injili niliyowahubiria. Mliipokea, nanyi mmesimama imara ndani yake, \v 2 na kupitia hiyo mnaokolewa, ikiwa mnashika kwa uthabiti ujumbe kama nilivyowahubiria. La sivyo, mliamini bure.
sw.R: Ndugu, nataka kuwakumbusha habari njema niliyowaambia. Mliipokea, nanyi mmesimama imara ndani yake. \v 2 Kupitia habari njema hiyo Mungu anawaokoa, ikiwa mnaushika ujumbe huo kama nilivyowaambia. Msipoushika, kuamini kwenu kulikuwa bure.

vi.L: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi nhắc cho anh chị em biết Tin Lành mà tôi đã rao giảng cho anh chị em, là Tin Lành anh chị em cũng đã nhận, và trong đó anh chị em cũng đang đứng vững, \v 2 nhờ đó anh chị em cũng đang được cứu, [nếu anh chị em giữ] lời tôi đã rao giảng cho anh chị em, nếu anh chị em giữ vững, trừ khi anh chị em đã tin cách vô ích.
vi.B: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi xin trình bày lại cho anh chị em Tin Lành mà tôi đã rao giảng cho anh chị em. Anh chị em đã nhận Tin Lành ấy, đang đứng vững trong Tin Lành ấy, \v 2 và nhờ Tin Lành ấy mà anh chị em đang được cứu, nếu anh chị em giữ vững sứ điệp đúng như tôi đã rao giảng. Nếu không, anh chị em đã tin cách vô ích.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi muốn nhắc lại cho anh chị em Tin Lành mà tôi đã nói với anh chị em. Anh chị em đã tiếp nhận Tin Lành ấy, và anh chị em đang đứng vững trong đó. \v 2 Qua Tin Lành ấy, Đức Chúa Trời đang cứu anh chị em, miễn là anh chị em giữ chặt sứ điệp đúng như tôi đã nói với anh chị em. Nếu không, việc anh chị em tin cũng thành vô ích.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 내가 여러분에게 전한 복음을 여러분에게 알려 드립니다. 여러분은 그것을 받았고, 그 안에 서 있으며, \v 2 그것을 통하여 구원을 받고 있습니다. 내가 여러분에게 어떤 말로 복음을 전했는지 [기억하여] 굳게 붙들고 있다면 말입니다. 그렇지 않으면 여러분은 헛되이 믿은 것입니다.
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 내가 여러분에게 전한 복음을 다시 한번 밝혀 두려고 합니다. 여러분은 그 복음을 받았고, 그 안에 굳게 서 있습니다. \v 2 그리고 여러분은 그 복음으로 구원을 받고 있습니다. 내가 전한 그대로 그 말씀을 굳게 붙들고 있다면 말입니다. 그렇지 않다면 여러분은 헛되이 믿은 것입니다.
ko.R: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 내가 여러분에게 전한 기쁜 소식을 다시 생각나게 해 주려고 합니다. 여러분은 그 소식을 받아들였고, 지금도 그 안에 굳게 서 있습니다. \v 2 하나님께서는 그 소식을 통해 여러분을 구원하고 계십니다. 다만 내가 전한 그대로 그 말씀을 붙들고 있어야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 여러분의 믿음은 아무 소용이 없습니다.

pt.L: Ora, eu lhes faço saber, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, o evangelho que eu lhes anunciei, o qual vocês também receberam, no qual também estão firmes, \v 2 pelo qual também estão sendo salvos, com que palavra eu [o] anunciei a vocês, se o estão retendo, a não ser que vocês tenham crido em vão.
pt.B: {{gender:Irmãos e irmãs|Irmãos}}, quero expor a vocês mais uma vez o evangelho que lhes anunciei. Vocês o receberam e nele estão firmes, \v 2 e por meio dele estão sendo salvos, se continuarem apegados à mensagem tal como eu a anunciei a vocês. Do contrário, vocês creram em vão.
pt.R: {{gender:Irmãos e irmãs|Irmãos}}, quero lembrar a vocês as boas-novas que eu lhes contei. Vocês aceitaram essa mensagem e continuam firmes nela. \v 2 Por meio dela Deus está salvando vocês, desde que continuem agarrados à mensagem do jeito que eu a contei. Se não fizerem isso, a fé que vocês tiveram não terá servido para nada.

am.L: አሁንም፣ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ የሰበክኩላችሁን ወንጌል አስታውቃችኋለሁ፤ እርሱን ደግሞ ተቀበላችሁ፤ በእርሱም ደግሞ ቆማችኋል፤ \v 2 በእርሱም ደግሞ እየዳናችሁ ናችሁ፤ በምን ቃል እንደ ሰበክኩላችሁ [አስታውቃችኋለሁ]፤ ይህም አጥብቃችሁ የምትይዙት ከሆነ ነው፤ በከንቱ ካላመናችሁ በቀር።
am.B: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ የሰበክኩላችሁን ወንጌል እንደ ገና ላስረዳችሁ እወዳለሁ። እርሱን ተቀበላችሁ፤ በእርሱም ጸንታችሁ ቆማችኋል። \v 2 የሰበክኩላችሁን ቃል እንደ ሰበክኩላችሁ አጥብቃችሁ ብትይዙ፣ በእርሱ እየዳናችሁ ነው። አለዚያ ማመናችሁ ከንቱ ነው።
am.R: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ የነገርኳችሁን የምሥራች ላስታውሳችሁ እፈልጋለሁ። እናንተም ተቀበላችሁት፤ በእርሱም ጸንታችሁ ቆማችኋል። \v 2 መልእክቱን ልክ እንደ ነገርኳችሁ አጥብቃችሁ ከያዛችሁ፣ እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ በኩል እያዳናችሁ ነው። ካልያዛችሁት ግን ማመናችሁ ከንቱ ነው።

hi.L: अब, {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, मैं तुम्हें वह सुसमाचार बताता हूँ जो मैंने तुम्हें सुनाया, जिसे तुमने ग्रहण भी किया, जिसमें तुम स्थिर भी हो, \v 2 जिसके द्वारा तुम्हारा उद्धार भी हो रहा है, यदि उस वचन को, जिससे मैंने तुम्हें सुसमाचार सुनाया, थामे रहते हो, नहीं तो तुमने व्यर्थ विश्वास किया।
hi.B: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, मैं फिर से तुम्हारे सामने वह सुसमाचार रखता हूँ जो मैंने तुम्हें सुनाया। तुमने उसे ग्रहण किया, तुम उसमें स्थिर खड़े हो, \v 2 और उसी के द्वारा तुम्हारा उद्धार हो रहा है, यदि तुम उस संदेश को वैसे ही थामे रहो जैसे मैंने उसे तुम्हें सुनाया था। नहीं तो तुम्हारा विश्वास करना व्यर्थ हुआ।
hi.R: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, मैं तुम्हें वह सुसमाचार याद दिलाना चाहता हूँ जो मैंने तुम्हें सुनाया था। तुमने उसे अपनाया, और तुम उसमें मज़बूती से खड़े हो। \v 2 उसी के द्वारा परमेश्वर तुम्हारा उद्धार कर रहे हैं, जब तक तुम उस संदेश को ठीक वैसे ही थामे रहते हो जैसे मैंने तुम्हें सुनाया था। अगर ऐसा नहीं, तो तुम्हारा विश्वास करना बेकार गया।

ru.L: Напоминаю же вам, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, Евангелие, которое я возвестил вам, которое вы и приняли, в котором вы и стоите, \v 2 которым вы и спасаетесь, — каким словом я возвестил [его] вам, если вы держитесь [его], разве только вы поверили напрасно.
ru.B: {{gender:Братья и сёстры|Братья}}, я снова излагаю вам Евангелие, которое возвестил вам. Вы приняли его, вы твёрдо стоите в нём, \v 2 и через него вы спасаетесь, если держитесь этой вести так, как я её вам возвестил. Иначе вы уверовали напрасно.
ru.R: {{gender:Братья и сёстры|Братья}}, я хочу напомнить вам Радостную весть, которую я вам рассказал. Вы приняли её и твёрдо стоите в ней. \v 2 Через неё Бог спасает вас, если вы держитесь этой вести в точности так, как я вам её рассказал. Если же нет, ваша вера была напрасной.

uk.L: А я даю вам знати, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, Євангеліє, яке я вам звістив, яке ви й прийняли, у якому ви й стоїте, \v 2 через яке ви й спасаєтеся, яким словом я звістив [його] вам, якщо ви [його] тримаєтеся, хіба що ви марно повірили.
uk.B: {{gender:Брати і сестри|Брати}}, я знову викладаю вам Євангеліє, яке я вам звістив. Ви прийняли його, ви твердо стоїте в ньому, \v 2 і через нього ви спасаєтеся, якщо тримаєтеся звістки так, як я вам її звістив. Інакше ви повірили намарно.
uk.R: {{gender:Брати і сестри|Брати}}, дозвольте нагадати вам Добру звістку, яку я вам розповів. Ви прийняли її і твердо стоїте в ній. \v 2 Через неї Бог спасає вас, якщо ви тримаєтеся звістки саме так, як я вам її розповів. Якщо ні, то ваша віра була марною.

ja.L: さて、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしがあなたがたに告げ知らせた福音を、あなたがたに知らせます。あなたがたはそれを受け入れ、その中に立っており、\v 2 それによって救われつつあります。わたしがどんな言葉で告げ知らせたかを、あなたがたがしっかり保っているならばです。もっとも、あなたがたがむなしく信じたのでなければの話ですが。
ja.B: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしがあなたがたに告げ知らせた福音を、もう一度はっきり示しておきます。あなたがたはこの福音を受け入れ、この福音にしっかりと立っています。\v 2 そして、この福音によって救われつつあるのです。ただし、わたしが告げ知らせたとおりの言葉を、しっかり守っているならばです。そうでなければ、あなたがたが信じたことはむだになってしまいます。
ja.R: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしがみなさんに伝えた良い知らせを、もう一度思い出してほしいのです。みなさんはそれを受け入れ、それにしっかりと立っています。\v 2 そして、神はその良い知らせによって、みなさんを救ってくださっています。ただし、それは、わたしが伝えたとおりの言葉を、みなさんがしっかりと守り続けているならばです。そうでなければ、みなさんが信じたことは、むだになってしまいます。

decisions.choice: I make known: here, I set out again what they already know, as the ground for the argument that follows
decisions.reason: Γνωρίζω usually means to make something known, but the Corinthians have already received this gospel and stand in it (verses 1-2). Paul restates it so that he can build on it in verses 12-34.

decisions.choice: are being saved: salvation as something under way, to be completed at the end
alternatives: are saved, as a finished state
decisions.reason: σῴζεσθε is present tense, as in 1:18 ("us who are being saved"). The salvation that began when they believed reaches its goal at the resurrection, the subject of this chapter.

decisions.choice: if you hold fast: the condition is that they keep hold of the message in the form in which Paul proclaimed it
alternatives: "I make known ... in what words I proclaimed it", taking the phrase with the opening verb
decisions.reason: The order of τίνι λόγῳ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν εἰ κατέχετε is unusual, with the question word placed before the condition. Read with κατέχετε ("you hold fast"), it says what they must keep hold of: the gospel as Paul put it to them, which he now repeats in verses 3-5.

decisions.choice: in vain: to no purpose, a faith that would come to nothing
decisions.reason: εἰκῇ can mean either. Verses 14 and 17 show what Paul has in mind: faith would be empty and futile if Christ had not been raised. He does not think this is so; the clause sharpens the warning against denying the resurrection.

decisions.choice: I am setting out for you once more
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that Paul is restating what they already know (m1); Readable says "let me remind you".

decisions.choice: God is saving you
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who saves, which the passive leaves unstated.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} for the readers, as elsewhere in the letter
decisions.reason: As in English, the church is addressed as men and women together; "frères" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: l’Évangile (L, B); la bonne nouvelle (R)
alternatives: la bonne nouvelle at every level
decisions.reason: As in Colossians (style guide 9): Readable says "good news" because "Évangile" is church language; the capital marks the message itself.

decisions.choice: el evangelio (L, B); la buena noticia (R) (chapter 15)
quiero recordarles
decisions.reason: The verb "make known" here sets out again what they already know (m1). Balanced says "recordar", as the English "setting out for you once more"; Literal keeps "hacer saber".

decisions.choice: ndugu, no gender span
decisions.reason: As 1:10: "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so the English gender spans in this chapter (verses 1, 6, 50, 58) have no Swahili counterpart; nor do those on "watu" and "mtu".

decisions.choice: mnaokolewa
decisions.reason: The Swahili present "-na-" says that salvation is under way, to be completed at the end (meaning decision), as the English "are being saved"; the perfect "mmeokolewa" would say it is already complete.

decisions.choice: "đang được cứu" for the present sozesthe
decisions.reason: The present tense describes salvation under way, to be completed at the end (m2), as "đang được cứu" in 1:18; Readable names God as the one who saves, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "알려 드립니다" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek "I make known"; the polite "-어 드리다" softens what is a reminder of what they already know, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: "구원을 받고 있습니다" (L, B); "구원하고 계십니다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads salvation as under way now, to be completed at the end, as in 1:18.

decisions.choice: ወንጌል (gospel) at Literal and Balanced; የምሥራች (good news) at Readable
decisions.reason: As in the Gospels and the shared terms for Paul's letters: "ወንጌል" is the church word readers know for the message, and Readable uses the plain "የምሥራች" as the English Readable says "good news". The verb is "ሰበክኩ" (I proclaimed) at Literal and Balanced and "ነገርኳችሁ" (I told you) at Readable.

decisions.choice: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}
decisions.reason: The whole church, women and men, is addressed, so the inclusive vocative is the default, as through the letter.

decisions.choice: напоминаю (L); снова излагаю (B); хочу напомнить (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means "make known", but here Paul sets out again what they already know (meaning decision m1); Russian says so at every level, as the English Balanced and Readable do.

decisions.choice: {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}
decisions.reason: Paul addresses the whole church, women and men; the key-term span of Paul's letters.

decisions.choice: спасаєтеся (imperfective present)
decisions.reason: Salvation is under way and completed at the end (m2); the Ukrainian imperfective present keeps that, as in 1:18.

decisions.choice: "救われつつあります" (L, B); "救ってくださっています" (R)
decisions.reason: Salvation as something under way, to be completed at the end (m2).

source.text: Παρέδωκα γὰρ ὑμῖν ἐν πρώτοις, ὃ καὶ παρέλαβον, ὅτι Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν κατὰ τὰς γραφάς, καὶ ὅτι ἐτάφη, καὶ ὅτι ἐγήγερται τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ κατὰ τὰς γραφάς, καὶ ὅτι ὤφθη Κηφᾷ, εἶτα τοῖς δώδεκα·

records.literal_gloss: I handed on for to you among first [things], what also I received, that Christ died for the sins of us according to the scriptures, \v 4 and that he was buried, and that he has been raised on the day the third according to the scriptures, \v 5 and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve;

en.L: For I handed on to you among [the] first things what I also received: that {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} died for our sins according to the Scriptures, \v 4 and that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was buried, and that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has been raised on the third day according to the Scriptures, \v 5 and that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to Cephas, then to the Twelve.
en.B: What I handed on to you, as the first and chief thing, I myself had received: that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} died for our sins, in keeping with the Scriptures; \v 4 that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was buried; that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has been raised on the third day, in keeping with the Scriptures; \v 5 and that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to Cephas, and after that to the Twelve.
en.R: I passed on to you the most important message of all, the one that was passed on to me. {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} died for our sins, just as the Scriptures said would happen. \v 4 He was buried. God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to life on the third day, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is alive, just as the Scriptures said. \v 5 He appeared to Peter, and then to the Twelve, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} closest followers.

fr.L: Car je vous ai transmis, parmi les premières [choses], ce que j’ai aussi reçu : que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est mort pour nos péchés selon les Écritures, \v 4 et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été enseveli, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été ressuscité le troisième jour selon les Écritures, \v 5 et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à Céphas, puis aux Douze.
fr.B: Ce que je vous ai transmis en tout premier lieu, je l’avais moi-même reçu : que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est mort pour nos péchés, conformément aux Écritures ; \v 4 qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été enseveli ; qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été ressuscité le troisième jour, conformément aux Écritures ; \v 5 et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à Céphas, et ensuite aux Douze.
fr.R: Je vous ai transmis le message le plus important de tous, celui que j’avais moi-même reçu. Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est mort pour nos péchés, comme les Écritures l’avaient annoncé. \v 4 Il a été mis au tombeau. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité le troisième jour, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est vivant, comme l’annonçaient les Écritures. \v 5 Il est apparu à Pierre, puis aux Douze, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples les plus proches.

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:les|os}} entregué en primer lugar lo que también yo recibí: que {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} murió por nuestros pecados conforme a las Escrituras, \v 4 y que fue sepultado, y que ha sido resucitado al tercer día conforme a las Escrituras, \v 5 y que se apareció a Cefas, luego a los Doce.
es.B: Lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} transmití como lo primero y más importante es lo que yo mismo había recibido: que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} murió por nuestros pecados, de acuerdo con las Escrituras; \v 4 que fue sepultado; que ha sido resucitado al tercer día, de acuerdo con las Escrituras; \v 5 y que se apareció a Cefas, y después a los Doce.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} transmití el mensaje más importante de todos, el mismo que me transmitieron a mí. {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} murió por nuestros pecados, tal como habían dicho las Escrituras. \v 4 Fue sepultado. Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó al tercer día, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está vivo, tal como dicen las Escrituras. \v 5 Se apareció a Pedro, y después a los Doce, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos más cercanos.

sw.L: Kwa maana niliwakabidhi miongoni mwa mambo ya kwanza kile nilichopokea pia: kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu kulingana na Maandiko, \v 4 na kwamba alizikwa, na kwamba amefufuliwa siku ya tatu kulingana na Maandiko, \v 5 na kwamba alimtokea Kefa, kisha wale Kumi na Wawili.
sw.B: Kile nilichowakabidhi kama jambo la kwanza na kuu, mimi mwenyewe nilikuwa nimekipokea: kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, kama Maandiko yalivyosema; \v 4 kwamba alizikwa; kwamba amefufuliwa siku ya tatu, kama Maandiko yalivyosema; \v 5 na kwamba alimtokea Kefa, kisha wale Kumi na Wawili.
sw.R: Niliwapa ujumbe ulio muhimu kuliko yote, ule ambao mimi nami nilipewa. {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, kama Maandiko yalivyosema ingetokea. \v 4 Alizikwa. Mungu alimfufua siku ya tatu, na sasa yu hai, kama Maandiko yalivyosema. \v 5 Alimtokea Petro, kisha mitume kumi na wawili, wafuasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa karibu.

vi.L: Vì trước hết tôi đã truyền lại cho anh chị em điều chính tôi đã nhận: ấy là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã chết vì tội lỗi chúng ta theo Kinh Thánh, \v 4 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã được chôn, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã được làm cho sống lại vào ngày thứ ba theo Kinh Thánh, \v 5 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện ra với Sê-pha, rồi với nhóm Mười Hai.
vi.B: Điều tôi đã truyền lại cho anh chị em, như là điều trước hết và quan trọng nhất, chính tôi cũng đã nhận: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã chết vì tội lỗi chúng ta, đúng như Kinh Thánh; \v 4 {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã được chôn; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã được sống lại vào ngày thứ ba, đúng như Kinh Thánh; \v 5 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện ra với Sê-pha, rồi với nhóm Mười Hai.
vi.R: Tôi đã truyền lại cho anh chị em sứ điệp quan trọng nhất, là sứ điệp đã được truyền lại cho tôi. {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã chết vì tội lỗi chúng ta, đúng như Kinh Thánh đã nói trước. \v 4 Ngài đã được chôn. Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại vào ngày thứ ba, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang sống, đúng như Kinh Thánh đã nói. \v 5 Ngài đã hiện ra với Phi-e-rơ, rồi với nhóm Mười Hai, là những môn đồ thân cận nhất của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 내가 받은 것을 가장 먼저 여러분에게 전해 주었습니다. 곧 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 성경대로 우리 죄를 위하여 죽으시고, \v 4 묻히시고, 성경대로 사흘째 되는 날에 살리심을 받으시고, \v 5 게바에게 나타나시고, 그다음에 열두 [제자]에게 [나타나셨다는] 것입니다.
ko.B: 내가 여러분에게 가장 중요한 것으로 전해 준 것은 나도 받은 것입니다. 곧 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 성경에 기록된 대로 우리 죄를 위해 죽으셨고, \v 4 묻히셨으며, 성경에 기록된 대로 사흘째 되는 날에 다시 살아나셨고, \v 5 게바에게 나타나셨고, 그 뒤에 열두 제자에게 나타나셨다는 것입니다.
ko.R: 내가 여러분에게 전해 준 것은 모든 것 가운데 가장 중요한 소식입니다. 그것은 나도 전해 받은 소식입니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 성경에 기록된 그대로 우리 죄 때문에 죽으셨습니다. \v 4 그분은 무덤에 묻히셨습니다. 하나님께서 사흘째 되는 날에 그분을 다시 살리셨고, 그분은 지금 살아 계십니다. 성경에 기록된 그대로입니다. \v 5 그분은 베드로에게 나타나셨고, 그다음에 그분의 가장 가까운 제자들인 열두 제자에게 나타나셨습니다.

pt.L: Pois eu lhes entreguei entre [as] primeiras coisas o que também recebi: que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} morreu pelos nossos pecados segundo as Escrituras, \v 4 e que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi sepultado, e que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi ressuscitado ao terceiro dia segundo as Escrituras, \v 5 e que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu a Cefas, depois aos Doze.
pt.B: O que eu lhes transmiti, como a primeira e principal coisa, eu mesmo tinha recebido: que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} morreu pelos nossos pecados, conforme as Escrituras; \v 4 que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi sepultado; que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi ressuscitado ao terceiro dia, conforme as Escrituras; \v 5 e que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu a Cefas e, depois, aos Doze.
pt.R: Eu passei a vocês a mensagem mais importante de todas, a mesma que foi passada a mim. {{christos:Cristo|O Messias}} morreu pelos nossos pecados, exatamente como as Escrituras tinham dito. \v 4 Ele foi sepultado. Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ressuscitou no terceiro dia, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está vivo, exatamente como as Escrituras disseram. \v 5 Ele apareceu a Pedro e depois aos Doze, os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} seguidores mais próximos.

am.L: እኔ ደግሞ የተቀበልኩትን በመጀመሪያ ከሆኑት [ነገሮች] መካከል ለእናንተ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻችኋለሁና፤ ይኸውም {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} እንደ መጻሕፍት ስለ ኃጢአታችን እንደ ሞተ፣ \v 4 እንደ ተቀበረም፣ እንደ መጻሕፍትም በሦስተኛው ቀን እንደ ተነሣ፣ \v 5 ለኬፋም ከዚያም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ እንደ ታየ ነው።
am.B: ለእናንተ ከሁሉ አስቀድሜና ከሁሉ አስበልጬ አሳልፌ የሰጠኳችሁን እኔ ራሴ ተቀብዬው ነበር፤ ይኸውም መጻሕፍት እንደሚሉት {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስለ ኃጢአታችን ሞተ፤ \v 4 ተቀበረ፤ መጻሕፍትም እንደሚሉት በሦስተኛው ቀን ተነሥቷል፤ \v 5 ለኬፋ ታየ፤ ከዚያም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ ታየ።
am.R: ለእኔ የተላለፈልኝን ከሁሉ የሚበልጠውን መልእክት ለእናንተ አስተላለፍኩ። ቅዱሳት መጻሕፍት አስቀድመው እንደ ተናገሩት {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስለ ኃጢአታችን ሞተ። \v 4 ተቀበረም። መጻሕፍት እንደ ተናገሩትም እግዚአብሔር በሦስተኛው ቀን ከሞት አስነሣው፤ እርሱም አሁን ሕያው ነው። \v 5 ለጴጥሮስ ታየ፤ ከዚያም የቅርብ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ለሆኑት ለአሥራ ሁለቱ ታየ።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैंने सबसे पहली बातों में तुम्हें वही सौंपा जो मैंने भी पाया था, कि मसीह पवित्रशास्त्र के अनुसार हमारे पापों के लिए मरे, \v 4 और कि वे गाड़े गए, और कि वे पवित्रशास्त्र के अनुसार तीसरे दिन जिलाए गए हैं, \v 5 और कि वे केफ़ा को दिखाई दिए, फिर बारहों को।
hi.B: जो मैंने सबसे पहली और मुख्य बात के रूप में तुम्हें सौंपा, वह मैंने स्वयं पाया था: कि मसीह पवित्रशास्त्र के वचन के अनुसार हमारे पापों के लिए मरे; \v 4 कि वे गाड़े गए; कि वे पवित्रशास्त्र के वचन के अनुसार तीसरे दिन जिलाए गए हैं; \v 5 और कि वे केफ़ा को दिखाई दिए, और उसके बाद बारहों को।
hi.R: मैंने तुम्हें सबसे ज़रूरी संदेश सौंपा, वही जो मुझे सौंपा गया था। मसीह हमारे पापों के लिए मरे, ठीक वैसे ही जैसे पवित्रशास्त्र ने कहा था कि होगा। \v 4 वे गाड़े गए। परमेश्वर ने उन्हें तीसरे दिन फिर से जिलाया, और वे जीवित हैं, ठीक वैसे ही जैसे पवित्रशास्त्र ने कहा था। \v 5 वे पतरस को दिखाई दिए, और फिर बारहों को, यानी अपने सबसे निकट के चेलों को।

ru.L: Ведь я передал вам в первую очередь то, что и сам принял: что {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} умер за наши грехи по Писаниям, \v 4 и что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был погребён, и что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} воскрешён в третий день по Писаниям, \v 5 и что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явился Кифе, затем Двенадцати.
ru.B: То, что я передал вам как самое первое и главное, я и сам принял: что {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} умер за наши грехи, как сказано в Писаниях; \v 4 что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был погребён; что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} воскрешён на третий день, как сказано в Писаниях; \v 5 и что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явился Кифе, а потом Двенадцати.
ru.R: Я передал вам самую важную весть, которую и сам получил. {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} умер за наши грехи, как и говорили Писания. \v 4 Его похоронили. Бог воскресил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} на третий день, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} жив, как и говорили Писания. \v 5 Он явился Петру, а потом Двенадцати, своим самым близким ученикам.

uk.L: Бо я передав вам насамперед те, що й прийняв: що {{christos:Христос|Месія}} помер за наші гріхи згідно з Писаннями, \v 4 і що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} був похований, і що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} воскрешений третього дня згідно з Писаннями, \v 5 і що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився Кифі, потім Дванадцятьом.
uk.B: Те, що я передав вам як найперше й найголовніше, я сам прийняв: що {{christos:Христос|Месія}} помер за наші гріхи, як і сказано в Писаннях; \v 4 що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} був похований; що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} воскрешений третього дня, як і сказано в Писаннях; \v 5 і що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився Кифі, а потім Дванадцятьом.
uk.R: Я передав вам найважливішу звістку з усіх, ту, яку передали мені. {{christos:Христос|Месія}} помер за наші гріхи, як і казали Писання. \v 4 Його поховали. Бог воскресив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} до життя третього дня, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} живий, як і казали Писання. \v 5 Він зʼявився Петрові, а потім Дванадцятьом, {{deity_pronoun:своїм|Своїм}} найближчим учням.

ja.L: というのは、わたしは、自分も受け取ったことを、何よりもまず第一に、あなたがたに伝えたからです。それは、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}が聖書に従ってわたしたちの罪のために死なれたこと、\v 4 また葬られたこと、また聖書に従って三日目に起こされていること、\v 5 またケファに現れられ、次に十二人に[現れられた]ことです。
ja.B: わたしがあなたがたに、まず第一のこととして手渡したのは、わたし自身も受け継いだことでした。すなわち、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は、聖書が示しているとおり、わたしたちの罪のために死なれました。\v 4 そして葬られ、聖書が示しているとおり、三日目によみがえらされました。\v 5 そして、ケファに姿を現され、その後、十二人に姿を現されました。
ja.R: わたしは、いちばん大切な知らせを、みなさんに伝えました。それは、わたしも人から伝えられたものです。{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は、聖書に書かれていたとおり、わたしたちの罪のために死なれました。\v 4 そして、葬られました。神は、三日目にこの方をよみがえらせてくださり、この方は今も生きておられます。それも、聖書に書かれていたとおりです。\v 5 この方はペトロに姿を現され、それから、いちばん近くにいた十二人の弟子たちに姿を現されました。

decisions.choice: handed on ... received: the words for passing on a tradition faithfully, from teacher to learner
decisions.reason: Παρέδωκα and παρέλαβον are the pair Paul uses for the Lord's Supper in 11:23 and for the traditions in 11:2, and ὑπὲρ in verse 1 is the Corinthians' side of it. The lines that follow, each beginning with ὅτι ("that"), read like a fixed summary Paul was taught and taught in turn. He also says that his gospel came to him by revelation (Galatians 1:11-12); the two do not conflict, since what he was taught agreed with what the risen Lord showed him.

decisions.choice: among the first things: as of first importance, the heart of the gospel
alternatives: first in time, the first thing I taught you
decisions.reason: ἐν πρώτοις can mean first in order of time or first in importance. Both may be meant: this was where Paul began, and it is what everything else rests on.

decisions.choice: according to the Scriptures: Christ's death for sins and his being raised happened as the Scriptures of Israel said, without one passage being named
decisions.reason: Paul names no text. For a death "for our sins", the clearest candidate is Isaiah 53:4-12, where the servant bears the sins of many. For the raising, Psalm 16:10 is used of Jesus' resurrection in Acts 2:25-31, and some connect "on the third day" with Hosea 6:2 or with Jonah 1:17 (compare Matthew 12:40). It is not certain whether the second phrase goes with "on the third day" or with the raising as a whole.

decisions.choice: has been raised: raised once and still alive
alternatives: was raised, as a past event only
decisions.reason: The other verbs in the list, ἀπέθανεν ("died"), ἐτάφη ("was buried") and ὤφθη ("appeared"), look back on single events. ἐγήγερται alone is a perfect: Christ was raised and lives now. Paul keeps this tense all through verses 12-20. The passive means that God raised him (verse 15).

decisions.choice: was buried: his death was real and complete
decisions.reason: Burial confirms death. The four lines go together in pairs: he died and was buried; he was raised and was seen.

decisions.choice: Cephas is Peter; the Twelve is the name of the group Jesus chose
decisions.reason: Cephas is the Aramaic name Jesus gave Peter (John 1:42), as in 1:12. "The Twelve" was the group's name even when Judas was no longer among them; Luke 24:33 speaks of "the Eleven" at this point.

decisions.choice: follow the SBLGNT: "the Twelve"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts, mainly Western witnesses, read "the Eleven", which looks like a correction to account for Judas. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: What I handed on to you ... I myself had received
alternatives: For I handed on to you ... what I also received
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the same pattern as 11:23, putting the teaching they already have first.

decisions.choice: in keeping with the Scriptures
decisions.reason: Balanced says plainly that the events match what the Scriptures say; Literal keeps the traditional form. Readable says "just as the Scriptures said".

decisions.choice: God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to life ... and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is alive; Peter; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} closest followers
alternatives: has been raised; Cephas; the Twelve
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who raised him and spells out the lasting result of the perfect (m4). It uses the name Peter, as the book does at Readable (1:12), and says who the Twelve were.

decisions.choice: le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, with the article outside the span at every level
decisions.reason: "Messie" needs the article in French, and "le Christ" reads naturally too, so the article stands outside the span (style guide 7). Literal adds it without brackets, as in Colossians, although the Greek has none.

decisions.choice: il a été ressuscité (L, B); Dieu l’a ressuscité (R); la résurrection, ressusciter, throughout the chapter
decisions.reason: The passive keeps God as the one who raises, as the English "has been raised" does, and the perfect of the Greek, raised once and still alive (m4), is carried by the passé composé. "Il est ressuscité", the usual French, makes Christ the subject of an intransitive verb. Readable names God, as the English does.

decisions.choice: entregar ... recibir (L); transmitir ... recibir (B); transmitir (R)
decisions.reason: The pair are the words for handing on a tradition faithfully (m1). Literal keeps "entregar", the plain sense of the Greek verb; Balanced and Readable say "transmitir", the Spanish word for passing on a teaching.

decisions.choice: ha sido resucitado (L, B); Dios lo resucitó (R) (chapter 15)
decisions.reason: The Greek perfect means raised once and still alive (m4), so Literal and Balanced say "ha sido resucitado" each time it comes back in the chapter, as the English "has been raised"; Readable names God as the one who raised him and adds "está vivo". The noun is "resurrección" (L, B), and Readable says "resucitar".

decisions.choice: Cefas (L, B); Pedro (R); los Doce (L, B); los Doce, sus discípulos más cercanos (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:12 and 9:5 for Cephas. "Los Doce" is the name of the group; Readable explains it with "discípulos", never "seguidores".

decisions.choice: niliwakabidhi ... nilichopokea
decisions.reason: The pair for passing on a tradition faithfully (meaning decision): "kukabidhi" (hand over), the settled word for this verb, and "kupokea" (receive). Readable says simply "kuwapa ... nilipewa" (give, be given).

decisions.choice: amefufuliwa
decisions.reason: The Swahili perfect "ame-" says raised once and alive still (meaning decision), as the English "has been raised"; it is used for this form all through the chapter, with "ufufuo" for resurrection.

decisions.choice: Kefa (L, B); Petro (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice of 1:12; "wale Kumi na Wawili" (L, B) and "mitume kumi na wawili" (R) are the settled New Testament names for the Twelve.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives
decisions.reason: As in chapter 1: most pronouns for Christ and God in this chapter are prefixes inside the verb ("alizikwa", "alimtokea"), which cannot take a capital, so the English spans on he and him have no Swahili counterpart; "wake", "yake", "yeye", "kwake" and "mwenyewe" take the span.

decisions.choice: "đã được làm cho sống lại" (L); "đã được sống lại" (B); "Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến Ngài sống lại, và Ngài đang sống" (R) for the perfect egegertai (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice keeps the perfect "has been raised": raised once and still alive (m4). Literal keeps the passive with God as the unnamed agent; Readable names God and adds that he lives, as the English does. "Sự sống lại" is kept for anastasis (15:12-13, 15:21, 15:42).

decisions.choice: "nhóm Mười Hai" for "the Twelve"; "Sê-pha" (L, B), "Phi-e-rơ" (R)
decisions.reason: The name of the group in the Vietnamese Mark (10:32); Readable says who they were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "살리심을 받으셨다" (L); "다시 살아나셨다" (B); "하나님께서 다시 살리셨다 ... 지금 살아 계십니다" (R), for the perfect "has been raised" through the chapter
decisions.reason: Korean verbs do not mark the Greek perfect, so Literal keeps the passive "was raised" of the Greek ("살리심을 받다"), and Readable adds "and he is alive", as the English does, to show that he remains raised. "다시 살아나다" is the verb of Romans 14:9.

decisions.choice: "성경대로" (L); "성경에 기록된 대로" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase as the Scriptures of Israel as a whole, with no one passage named.

decisions.choice: "열두 [제자]" (L); "열두 제자" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "The Twelve" is the name of the group; Korean needs the noun, which John 6:67 (L) brackets in the same way.

decisions.choice: foi ressuscitado (L, B); Deus o ressuscitou ... e ele está vivo (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole chapter. Portuguese "ressuscitar" is both intransitive ("ressuscitou", he rose) and transitive ("Deus o ressuscitou"). Literal and Balanced use the passive "foi ressuscitado" wherever the Greek has the passive, so that God stays the one who raises (m4), and "os mortos não são ressuscitados" for the general rule; Readable says "Deus o ressuscitou" and "os mortos não ressuscitam", as the English Readable says "God raised" and "the dead do not rise". Portuguese has no compound tense for "has been raised": "tem sido ressuscitado" would mean a repeated act. So the perfect is "foi ressuscitado", and its lasting result (m4) is spelled out at Readable ("está vivo"), as in English.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, with the article inside the alternative at every level
decisions.reason: Portuguese says "Cristo morreu" without an article but cannot say "Messias morreu": the title needs "o". So the alternative carries its article at Literal too, and after a preposition both options carry it ("{{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}", "{{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}"), so that each option reads as Portuguese.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting for capitalised pronouns has nothing to change; pronouns for Christ and for God are written plainly through the chapter.

decisions.choice: ተነሥቷል / ተነሣ (has been raised) at Literal and Balanced; እግዚአብሔር ... አስነሣው (God raised him) at Readable; the noun is ትንሣኤ
alternatives: a passive form such as ተነሣሥቷል
decisions.reason: Amharic says "ተነሣ" both for rising and for being raised, so Literal and Balanced use it for the Greek passive, with the perfect "ተነሥቷል" where the sentence allows; Readable names God as the one who raises, as the English Readable does. The same verb and the noun "ትንሣኤ" carry the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: no christos span
decisions.reason: "मसीह" is both the name and the word Messiah, so the choice the English setting offers is already made (style guide section 7). This holds for the whole file.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English pronoun setting has nothing to change; respect for Christ is carried by the honorific "वे", "गाड़े गए", "दिखाई दिए" (style guide section 7). This holds for the whole file.

decisions.choice: "जिलाए गए हैं"
decisions.reason: The Greek is passive and perfect: raised by God, and still alive (meaning decision m4). "जिलाए गए हैं" keeps both, as "जी उठे" would not; Readable names God as the one who raised him.

decisions.choice: "केफ़ा" (L, B); "पतरस" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:12 and 9:5.

decisions.choice: воскрешён
decisions.reason: The Greek perfect passive says that Christ was raised, by God, and is alive (meaning decision m4). Russian "воскрешён" keeps the passive through this chapter, where Paul argues from God's act (verse 15); "воскрес" would make Christ the one who acts. Readable names God as the English does.

decisions.choice: Кифа (L, B); Пётр (R)
decisions.reason: As in 9:5: Paul uses Peter's Aramaic name; Readable uses the name readers know.

decisions.choice: воскрешений (L, B); Бог воскресив (R), for egēgertai through chapter 15; воскресіння for anastasis
decisions.reason: The Corinthians note: the perfect is "has been raised", raised once and still alive (m4). The Ukrainian perfective passive participle "воскрешений" says that, and keeps God as the one who raises; "воскрес" would make Christ the subject. Readable names God, as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:своїм|Своїм}}
decisions.reason: The English Readable puts a span on "his". The Ukrainian reflexive "свій" is exempt by the style guide, but here it stands where the English has the span, so the span is kept; a reviewer may drop it.

decisions.choice: "起こされている" (L); "よみがえらされました" (B); "神は……よみがえらせてくださり" (R), through chapter 15
decisions.reason: God is the one who raised Christ, once and for ever (m4); the passive keeps God as the actor, and the forms follow egeirō in 6:14.

decisions.choice: Light respect forms for Christ in the creed: "死なれた", "現れられ" (L), "姿を現され" (B, R)
decisions.reason: What Jesus does takes the light respect forms in a letter as in narration (style 4, 7a); "葬られた" is a plain passive.

source.text: ἔπειτα ὤφθη ἐπάνω πεντακοσίοις ἀδελφοῖς ἐφάπαξ, ἐξ ὧν οἱ πλείονες μένουσιν ἕως ἄρτι, τινὲς δὲ ἐκοιμήθησαν·

records.literal_gloss: then he appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, of whom the most remain until now, some but fell asleep;

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to more than 500 {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} at one time, of whom the greater part remain until now, but some have fallen asleep.
en.B: Next {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to more than 500 {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} on a single occasion. Most of them are alive to this day, but some have died.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to more than 500 {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} at one time. Most of them are still alive today, but some have died.

fr.L: Ensuite {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à plus de 500 {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} à la fois, dont la plupart demeurent jusqu’à présent, mais quelques-uns se sont endormis.

fr.R: Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à plus de 500 {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} en même temps. La plupart d’entre eux sont encore en vie aujourd’hui, mais certains sont morts.

es.L: Después se apareció a más de 500 hermanos a la vez, de los cuales la mayoría permanece hasta ahora, pero algunos se han dormido.
es.B: Luego se apareció a más de 500 hermanos en una sola ocasión. La mayoría de ellos vive todavía, pero algunos ya han muerto.
es.R: Luego se apareció a más de 500 hermanos a la vez. La mayoría de ellos todavía están vivos, pero algunos han muerto.

sw.L: Kisha akawatokea ndugu zaidi ya mia tano kwa wakati mmoja, ambao wengi wao wangalipo hadi sasa, lakini wengine wamelala.
sw.B: Kisha akawatokea ndugu zaidi ya mia tano kwa pamoja. Wengi wao bado wako hai hadi leo, ingawa wengine wamefariki.
sw.R: Kisha akawatokea ndugu zaidi ya mia tano kwa wakati mmoja. Wengi wao bado wako hai leo, lakini baadhi yao wamekufa.

vi.B: Kế đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện ra với hơn năm trăm {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} trong cùng một lần. Phần đông trong số họ vẫn còn sống đến ngày nay, nhưng một số đã qua đời.
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện ra với hơn năm trăm {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} cùng một lúc. Phần đông trong số họ vẫn còn sống ngày nay, nhưng một số đã chết.

ko.L: 그 뒤에 그분은 오백 명이 넘는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 한꺼번에 나타나셨는데, 그 가운데 대부분은 지금까지 살아 있고 몇 사람은 잠들었습니다.
ko.B: 그다음에 그분은 오백 명이 넘는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 한 번에 나타나셨습니다. 그 가운데 대부분은 지금도 살아 있지만, 몇 사람은 죽었습니다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 그분은 오백 명도 넘는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 한꺼번에 나타나셨습니다. 그들 가운데 대부분은 지금도 살아 있지만, 몇 사람은 죽었습니다.

pt.R: Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu a mais de quinhentos {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} ao mesmo tempo. A maioria deles ainda está viva hoje, mas alguns já morreram.

am.L: ከዚያም ከ500 ለሚበልጡ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} በአንድ ጊዜ ታየ፤ ከእነርሱም አብዛኞቹ እስከ አሁን ይኖራሉ፤ አንዳንዶቹ ግን አንቀላፍተዋል።
am.B: ቀጥሎም ከ500 ለሚበልጡ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} በአንድ ጊዜ ታየ። ከእነርሱ አብዛኞቹ እስከ ዛሬ በሕይወት አሉ፤ አንዳንዶቹ ግን ሞተዋል።
am.R: ከዚያም ከ500 ለሚበልጡ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} በአንድ ጊዜ ታየ። ከእነርሱ ብዙዎቹ ዛሬም በሕይወት አሉ፤ አንዳንዶቹ ግን ሞተዋል።

hi.L: फिर वे एक ही समय में 500 से अधिक {{gender:भाई-बहनों|भाइयों}} को दिखाई दिए, जिनमें से अधिकांश अब तक बने हुए हैं, पर कुछ सो गए हैं।

hi.R: फिर वे एक ही समय में 500 से ज़्यादा {{gender:भाई-बहनों|भाइयों}} को दिखाई दिए। उनमें से ज़्यादातर अब भी जीवित हैं, पर कुछ मर गए हैं।

ru.L: Затем {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явился более чем 500 {{gender:братьям и сёстрам|братьям}} одновременно, из которых большая часть остаётся [в живых] до сих пор, а некоторые уснули.

uk.L: Потім {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився більше ніж пʼятистам {{gender:братам і сестрам|братам}} одночасно, з яких більшість живі досі, а деякі заснули.
uk.B: Згодом {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився більше ніж пʼятистам {{gender:братам і сестрам|братам}} одного разу. Більшість із них живі й донині, а деякі вже померли.
uk.R: Потім {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився більше ніж пʼятистам {{gender:братам і сестрам|братам}} водночас. Більшість із них ще живі, але деякі вже померли.

ja.L: その後、五百人以上の{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}に同時に現れられました。そのうちの大部分は今も残っていますが、ある人たちは眠りにつきました。
ja.B: 次に、五百人以上の{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}に一度に姿を現されました。そのうちの大部分は今も生きていますが、何人かはすでに亡くなりました。
ja.R: それから、五百人よりも多くの{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}に、一度に姿を現されました。その人たちのほとんどは今も生きていますが、何人かはもう死にました。

decisions.choice: brothers: fellow believers, men and women
decisions.reason: ἀδελφοῖς is Paul's usual word for members of the church, women included. Nothing limits this crowd to men, though ancient writers sometimes counted only the men in a crowd (Matthew 14:21).

decisions.choice: remain: are still alive
decisions.reason: Paul's point is that most of these witnesses can still be asked about what they saw.

decisions.choice: fell asleep: died
decisions.reason: ἐκοιμήθησαν is the gentle way of speaking of believers' death used in 7:39 and 11:30, which looks forward to waking at the resurrection, the subject of this chapter (verses 18, 20).

decisions.choice: have died
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the idiom (m3), as at 7:39 and 11:30; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: se sont endormis (L); sont morts (B, R), and the same in 15:18 and 15:20
alternatives: se sont endormis at every level
decisions.reason: As in English, Literal keeps the idiom, which French also knows ("s’endormir dans la paix"); Balanced and Readable give its meaning (m3).

decisions.choice: se han dormido (L); han muerto (B, R) (chapter 15)
decisions.reason: "Falling asleep" is an idiom for dying (m3). Literal keeps "dormirse", as in 7:39, and Balanced and Readable say "morir"; the same holds in verses 18, 20 and 51.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in 1:10: Spanish "hermanos" already includes women believers (m1).

decisions.choice: wamelala (L); wamefariki (B); wamekufa (R)
decisions.reason: As 7:39: Literal keeps the Greek picture of falling asleep, which Swahili Christian speech also uses for dying; Balanced "kufariki" and Readable "kufa" say it plainly, as the English does. The same pattern through chapter 15 (verses 18, 20, 51).

decisions.choice: "năm trăm" in words
decisions.reason: The style guide writes numbers in running text in words.

decisions.choice: "잠들다" (L); "죽다" (B, R), here and in verses 18, 20, 51, as in 7:39
decisions.reason: As settled at 7:39.

decisions.choice: አንቀላፍተዋል (have fallen asleep) at Literal; ሞተዋል (have died) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Amharic understands "አንቀላፋ" of a believer's death only in church speech, so Literal keeps the Greek picture and Balanced and Readable say plainly that they died, as the English does. The same split holds through the chapter.

decisions.choice: {{gender:भाई-बहनों|भाइयों}}
decisions.reason: The brothers are fellow believers, men and women (meaning decision m1), so the oblique inclusive form is the default, as the style guide has it.

decisions.choice: умерли (B, R); уснули (L)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the idiom (meaning decision m3), as in 11:30; Literal keeps "уснули".

decisions.choice: пʼятистам, in words
decisions.reason: The English writes the figure; Ukrainian running text spells out a round number, and the dative "пʼятистам" reads naturally.

decisions.choice: "五百人" in kanji numerals
decisions.reason: Kanji numerals in running text (style 5).

decisions.choice: "眠りにつきました" (L); "亡くなりました" (B), "死にました" (R)
decisions.reason: Fell asleep means died (m3); L keeps the picture as in 11:30.

source.text: ἔπειτα ὤφθη Ἰακώβῳ, εἶτα τοῖς ἀποστόλοις πᾶσιν·

records.literal_gloss: then he appeared to James, then to the apostles all;

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to James, and after him to all the apostles.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to James, the Lord's brother, and later to all the apostles.

fr.L: Ensuite {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à Jacques, puis à tous les apôtres.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à Jacques, et après lui à tous les apôtres.
fr.R: Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à Jacques, le frère du Seigneur, et plus tard à tous les apôtres.

es.L: Después se apareció a Santiago, luego a todos los apóstoles.
es.B: Luego se apareció a Santiago, y después a todos los apóstoles.
es.R: Luego se apareció a Santiago, el hermano del Señor, y más tarde a todos los apóstoles.

sw.L: Kisha akamtokea Yakobo, kisha mitume wote.
sw.B: Kisha akamtokea Yakobo, na baadaye mitume wote.
sw.R: Kisha akamtokea Yakobo, ndugu wa Bwana, na baadaye mitume wote.

vi.L: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện ra với Gia-cơ, rồi với tất cả các sứ đồ.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện ra với Gia-cơ, và sau đó với tất cả các sứ đồ.
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện ra với Gia-cơ, em của Chúa, và sau đó với tất cả các sứ đồ.

ko.L: 그 뒤에 야고보에게 나타나셨고, 그다음에 모든 사도에게 [나타나셨습니다].
ko.B: 그다음에 야고보에게 나타나셨고, 그 뒤에 모든 사도에게 나타나셨습니다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 주님의 동생 야고보에게 나타나셨고, 나중에 모든 사도에게 나타나셨습니다.

pt.L: Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu a Tiago, depois a todos os apóstolos.
pt.B: Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu a Tiago e, em seguida, a todos os apóstolos.
pt.R: Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu a Tiago, o irmão do Senhor, e mais tarde a todos os apóstolos.

am.L: ከዚያም ለያዕቆብ ታየ፤ ቀጥሎም ለሐዋርያት ሁሉ።
am.B: ከዚያም ለያዕቆብ ታየ፤ ከእርሱም በኋላ ለሐዋርያት ሁሉ ታየ።
am.R: ከዚያም ለጌታ ወንድም ለያዕቆብ ታየ፤ በኋላም ለሐዋርያት ሁሉ ታየ።

hi.L: फिर वे याकूब को दिखाई दिए, फिर सब प्रेरितों को।
hi.B: फिर वे याकूब को दिखाई दिए, और उसके बाद सब प्रेरितों को।
hi.R: फिर वे प्रभु के भाई याकूब को दिखाई दिए, और बाद में सब प्रेरितों को।

ru.L: Затем {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явился Иакову, потом всем апостолам.
ru.B: Потом {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явился Иакову, а после него всем апостолам.
ru.R: Потом {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явился Иакову, брату Господа, а позже всем апостолам.

uk.L: Потім {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився Якову, потім усім апостолам.
uk.B: Потім {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився Якову, а після нього всім апостолам.
uk.R: Потім {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився Якову, Господньому братові, а пізніше всім апостолам.

ja.L: その後、ヤコブに現れられ、次に、すべての使徒たちに[現れられました]。
ja.B: 次にヤコブに姿を現され、その後、すべての使徒たちに姿を現されました。
ja.R: そのあと、主の兄弟ヤコブに姿を現され、後に、すべての使徒たちにも姿を現されました。

decisions.choice: James: the brother of the Lord, later a leader of the church in Jerusalem
alternatives: James the son of Zebedee, one of the Twelve
decisions.reason: Paul calls this James "the Lord's brother" (Galatians 1:19) and names him among the pillars of the Jerusalem church (Galatians 2:9). Jesus' brothers did not believe in him during his ministry (John 7:5); an appearance to James helps explain the change. The son of Zebedee was already among the Twelve (verse 5).

decisions.choice: all the apostles: a wider group than the Twelve
decisions.reason: Paul uses "apostle" for more people than the Twelve: James (Galatians 1:19), Barnabas (9:5-6), Andronicus and Junia (Romans 16:7). "All" suggests a larger group than in verse 5, though which people are meant cannot be known.

decisions.choice: James, the Lord's brother
decisions.reason: Readable says which James is meant (m1), from Galatians 1:19.

decisions.choice: "Gia-cơ, em của Chúa" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Galatians 1:19 and 9:5 here: Vietnamese must say younger or older, and Readable says "em".

decisions.choice: "주님의 동생 야고보" (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable adds "the Lord's brother", as Galatians 1:19 says; Korean must choose between an older and a younger brother, and the Gospels name Jesus first among his brothers (Mark 6:3), so Readable says "동생".

source.text: ἔσχατον δὲ πάντων ὡσπερεὶ τῷ ἐκτρώματι ὤφθη κἀμοί.

records.literal_gloss: last but of all as if to the untimely birth he appeared also to me.

en.B: Last of all, as though to a child born before its time, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to me as well.
en.R: Finally {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to me too, though I was like a baby born at the wrong time.

fr.L: Et en dernier de tous, comme à l’avorton, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’est apparu à moi aussi.
fr.B: Et en tout dernier lieu, comme à un enfant né avant terme, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’est apparu à moi aussi.
fr.R: Enfin, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’est apparu à moi aussi, alors que j’étais comme un bébé né au mauvais moment.

es.L: Y al último de todos, como al abortivo, se me apareció también a mí.
es.B: Por último, como a un niño nacido fuera de tiempo, se me apareció también a mí.
es.R: Al final se me apareció también a mí, aunque yo era como un bebé nacido a destiempo.

sw.L: Na mwisho wa wote, kana kwamba kwa yule aliyezaliwa kabla ya wakati, alinitokea na mimi pia.
sw.B: Mwisho wa wote, alinitokea na mimi pia, kana kwamba kwa mtoto aliyezaliwa kabla ya wakati wake.
sw.R: Mwishowe alinitokea na mimi pia, ingawa nilikuwa kama mtoto aliyezaliwa wakati usiofaa.

vi.L: Và sau hết mọi người, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã hiện ra với tôi, như với một đứa trẻ sinh non.
vi.B: Sau cùng hết, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã hiện ra với tôi, như với một đứa trẻ sinh ra không đúng thời điểm.
vi.R: Cuối cùng, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã hiện ra với tôi, dù tôi giống như một đứa bé sinh ra không đúng lúc.

ko.L: 맨 나중에, 달이 차지 못하고 난 자 같은 나에게도 나타나셨습니다.
ko.B: 맨 마지막으로, 때가 되기도 전에 태어난 아이 같은 나에게도 나타나셨습니다.
ko.R: 마지막으로 그분은 나에게도 나타나셨습니다. 나는 때를 맞추지 못하고 태어난 아기와 같은 사람이었습니다.

pt.L: E por último de todos, como ao nascido fora do tempo, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu também a mim.
pt.B: Por último, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu também a mim, como a uma criança nascida antes do tempo.
pt.R: Por fim, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu também a mim, embora eu fosse como um bebê que nasceu na hora errada.

am.L: ከሁሉም በመጨረሻ ደግሞ ጊዜው ሳይደርስ ለተወለደ ያህል ለእኔም ታየ።
am.B: ከሁሉም በመጨረሻ፣ ጊዜው ሳይደርስ የተወለደ ሕፃን ለምመስለው ለእኔም ታየ።
am.R: በመጨረሻም ለእኔ ደግሞ ታየ፤ እኔ ግን ያለ ጊዜው እንደ ተወለደ ሕፃን ነበርኩ።

hi.L: और सब के बाद, मानो समय से पहले जन्मे हुए को, वे मुझे भी दिखाई दिए।
hi.B: सबसे अंत में, मानो समय से पहले जन्मे बच्चे को, वे मुझे भी दिखाई दिए।
hi.R: आख़िर में वे मुझे भी दिखाई दिए, यद्यपि मैं ऐसे बच्चे जैसा था जो ग़लत समय पर पैदा हुआ हो।

ru.L: А после всех, как бы выкидышу, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явился и мне.
ru.B: А после всех, словно ребёнку, родившемуся раньше срока, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явился и мне.
ru.R: И наконец {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явился и мне, хотя я был как ребёнок, родившийся не вовремя.

uk.L: А найостанніше з усіх, наче недоношеному, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився і мені.
uk.B: Останнім з усіх, наче дитині, народженій не вчасно, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився і мені.
uk.R: Нарешті {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявився і мені, хоч я був наче дитина, яка народилася не вчасно.

ja.L: そして、すべての者の最後に、月足らずで生まれた者のようなわたしにも、現れられました。
ja.B: そして最後に、時が満ちる前に生まれた子のようなわたしにも、姿を現してくださいました。
ja.R: わたしは、生まれるべきではない時に生まれた赤ちゃんのような者でした。それなのに、最後に、わたしにも姿を現してくださいました。

decisions.choice: untimely birth: a child born dead or too early, a picture of Paul's unfitness and of the abrupt, unnatural way he was made an apostle
alternatives: one born late, after the others
a term of abuse his opponents used of him ("freak")
decisions.reason: ἐκτρώματι means a miscarriage or stillborn child; the Greek Old Testament uses it that way (Numbers 12:12; Job 3:16). So the picture is of an unformed, abnormal birth rather than a late one. Verse 9 explains it: Paul was not fit to be an apostle. The article ("the untimely birth") may suggest a label others had used of him, but that cannot be shown.

decisions.choice: last of all: the appearance to Paul was the last of its kind, and of the same kind as the others
decisions.reason: Paul puts the risen Lord's appearance to him (9:1; Acts 9:3-6) in the same list as the appearances to Peter and the others, and at the end of it. This is the ground of his apostleship.

decisions.choice: a child born before its time (B); a baby born at the wrong time (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the picture in everyday words; Literal keeps "untimely birth".

decisions.choice: l’avorton (L); un enfant né avant terme (B)
decisions.reason: "Avorton" is the French word for a child born dead or too early, and like the Greek it can also be a word of contempt, which fits Paul's picture of his own unfitness (m1). Balanced gives the picture in everyday words, as the English does.

decisions.choice: el abortivo (L); un niño nacido fuera de tiempo (B); un bebé nacido a destiempo (R)
decisions.reason: The word names a child born dead or too early (m1). Literal keeps the hard Greek picture with "abortivo"; Balanced and Readable say a child born out of time, as the English does.

decisions.choice: aliyezaliwa kabla ya wakati
decisions.reason: A description rather than "njiti" (a premature baby, an everyday word that sounds affectionate) or "mimba iliyoharibika" (a miscarriage, which would narrow the picture); the meaning decision includes both a child born dead and one born too early.

decisions.choice: "달이 차지 못하고 난 자" (L); "때가 되기도 전에 태어난 아이" (B); "때를 맞추지 못하고 태어난 아기" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the picture as a child born dead or too early, uncertain and footnoted. "만삭" is an older word; "달이 차지 못하다" says it in current Korean.

decisions.choice: o nascido fora do tempo
decisions.reason: The traditional Portuguese word is "abortivo", but in today's Brazilian Portuguese that is an adjective for what causes an abortion (a drug), and "aborto" names the act; neither reads as a person. "O nascido fora do tempo" keeps the article and the picture of an abnormal birth (m1) at Literal.

decisions.choice: ጊዜው ሳይደርስ የተወለደ (born before its time)
decisions.reason: "ጭንጋፍ" names only a dead foetus and sounds coarse in modern speech; the meaning decision allows a child born dead or too early, and a phrase about untimely birth keeps both and Paul's point about the abrupt way he was made an apostle.

decisions.choice: выкидыш (L); ребёнок, родившийся раньше срока (B); родившийся не вовремя (R)
decisions.reason: The Synodal "извергу" is no longer understood. Literal keeps the harsh picture of meaning decision m1; Balanced and Readable say it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: недоношений
decisions.reason: m1: a child born dead or too early. "Недоношений" is the plain word for a premature birth; "викидень" is a miscarriage and sounds coarse.

decisions.choice: "月足らずで生まれた者" (L); "時が満ちる前に生まれた子" (B); "生まれるべきではない時に生まれた赤ちゃん" (R)
decisions.reason: A child born dead or too early, a picture of Paul's unfitness and his abrupt call (m1, uncertain, footnoted).

source.text: ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι ὁ ἐλάχιστος τῶν ἀποστόλων, ὃς οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς καλεῖσθαι ἀπόστολος, διότι ἐδίωξα τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ θεοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: I for am the least of the apostles, who not am fit to be called apostle, because I persecuted the church of the God;

en.L: For I am the least of the apostles, who am not fit to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
en.B: Among the apostles I am the least; I am not even fit to bear the name apostle, because I persecuted God's church.
en.R: You see, I am the least important of the apostles. I am not good enough even to be called an apostle, because I used to attack God's church.

fr.L: Car moi, je suis le moindre des apôtres, moi qui ne suis pas apte à être appelé apôtre, parce que j’ai persécuté l’Église de Dieu.
fr.B: Parmi les apôtres, je suis le plus petit ; je ne suis même pas qualifié pour porter le nom d’apôtre, parce que j’ai persécuté l’Église de Dieu.
fr.R: Voyez-vous, je suis le moins important des apôtres. Je ne suis même pas assez bon pour qu’on m’appelle apôtre, parce qu’autrefois je m’en prenais à l’Église de Dieu.

es.L: Porque yo soy el menor de los apóstoles, que no soy digno de ser llamado apóstol, porque perseguí a la iglesia de Dios.
es.B: Entre los apóstoles yo soy el menor; ni siquiera soy digno de llevar el nombre de apóstol, porque perseguí a la iglesia de Dios.
es.R: Es que yo soy el menos importante de los apóstoles. Ni siquiera merezco que me llamen apóstol, porque antes atacaba a la iglesia de Dios.

sw.L: Kwa maana mimi ni mdogo kuliko mitume wote, nisiyestahili kuitwa mtume, kwa sababu nililitesa kanisa la Mungu.
sw.B: Miongoni mwa mitume mimi ni mdogo kabisa; sistahili hata kuitwa mtume, kwa sababu nililitesa kanisa la Mungu.
sw.R: Mimi ni mtume mdogo kuliko wote. Sifai hata kuitwa mtume, kwa sababu zamani nilikuwa nikilishambulia kanisa la Mungu.

vi.L: Vì tôi là người nhỏ nhất trong các sứ đồ, là người không đáng được gọi là sứ đồ, vì tôi đã bắt bớ Hội Thánh của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Trong các sứ đồ, tôi là người nhỏ nhất; tôi không đáng được mang danh là sứ đồ, vì tôi đã bắt bớ Hội Thánh của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Anh chị em thấy đó, tôi là người kém quan trọng nhất trong các sứ đồ. Tôi không xứng đáng ngay cả được gọi là sứ đồ, vì trước kia tôi đã tấn công Hội Thánh của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 나는 사도들 가운데 가장 작은 사람이고, 사도라고 불릴 자격도 없는 사람입니다. 내가 하나님의 교회를 박해했기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 나는 사도들 가운데 가장 보잘것없는 사람입니다. 내가 하나님의 교회를 박해했으니, 사도라는 이름을 가질 자격조차 없습니다.
ko.R: 사실 나는 사도들 가운데 가장 하찮은 사람입니다. 나는 사도라고 불릴 만한 사람이 못 됩니다. 전에 하나님의 교회를 공격했기 때문입니다.

pt.L: Pois eu sou o menor dos apóstolos, que não sou apto para ser chamado apóstolo, porque persegui a Igreja de Deus.
pt.B: Entre os apóstolos, eu sou o menor; nem sequer estou à altura de levar o nome de apóstolo, porque persegui a Igreja de Deus.
pt.R: Vejam: eu sou o menos importante dos apóstolos. Não sou bom o bastante nem para ser chamado de apóstolo, porque eu atacava a Igreja de Deus.

am.L: እኔ ከሐዋርያት የማንስ ነኝና፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ስላሳደድኩ ሐዋርያ ተብዬ ልጠራ የማልበቃ ነኝ።
am.B: እኔ ከሐዋርያት መካከል ከሁሉ የማንስ ነኝ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ስላሳደድኩ ሐዋርያ የሚለውን ስም እንኳ ልሸከም አይገባኝም።
am.R: እንግዲህ እኔ ከሐዋርያት ሁሉ ዝቅተኛ ነኝ። የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ ክርስቲያን አጠቃ ስለ ነበርኩ፣ ሐዋርያ ተብዬ ልጠራ እንኳ አይገባኝም።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं प्रेरितों में सबसे छोटा हूँ, जो प्रेरित कहलाने के योग्य भी नहीं, क्योंकि मैंने परमेश्वर की कलीसिया को सताया।
hi.B: प्रेरितों में मैं सबसे छोटा हूँ; मैं प्रेरित कहलाने के योग्य भी नहीं, क्योंकि मैंने परमेश्वर की कलीसिया को सताया।
hi.R: देखो, मैं प्रेरितों में सबसे कम महत्व का हूँ। मैं तो प्रेरित कहलाने के लायक़ भी नहीं, क्योंकि मैं परमेश्वर की कलीसिया पर अत्याचार करता था।

ru.L: Ведь я наименьший из апостолов, который не достоин называться апостолом, потому что я гнал церковь Божью.
ru.B: Среди апостолов я самый меньший; я даже недостоин носить имя апостола, потому что преследовал Божью церковь.
ru.R: Видите ли, я самый незначительный из апостолов. Я даже недостоин называться апостолом, потому что раньше я нападал на Божью церковь.

uk.L: Бо я найменший з апостолів, який не гідний зватися апостолом, бо я переслідував церкву Божу.
uk.B: Серед апостолів я найменший; я навіть не гідний носити ймення апостола, бо переслідував Божу церкву.
uk.R: Бачите, я найменш важливий з усіх апостолів. Я навіть не заслуговую, щоб мене називали апостолом, бо колись нападав на Божу церкву.

ja.L: というのは、わたしは使徒たちの中で最も小さい者であり、使徒と呼ばれるにふさわしくない者だからです。神の教会を迫害したからです。
ja.B: わたしは使徒たちの中でいちばん取るに足りない者で、使徒という名を受ける資格さえありません。神の教会を迫害したからです。
ja.R: わたしは、使徒たちの中で、いちばんつまらない者なのです。使徒と呼ばれる資格さえありません。以前、神の教会を攻撃していたからです。

decisions.choice: the least: lowest in standing, because of his past
decisions.reason: Paul does not say he did the least work; verse 10 says the opposite. He is least because of what he did before he met the Lord.

decisions.choice: fit: qualified, good enough
decisions.reason: ἱκανὸς means sufficient or qualified, as in 2 Corinthians 2:16 and 3:5-6, where Paul says his fitness comes from God.

decisions.choice: persecuted: Paul hunted down believers before his conversion
decisions.reason: Acts 8:3 and 9:1-2 describe it, and Paul speaks of it in Galatians 1:13 and Philippians 3:6.

decisions.choice: used to attack
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plainer verb and marks it as something in Paul's past.

decisions.choice: apte (L); qualifié (B)
decisions.reason: The word means qualified, good enough (m2), as in Colossians 1:12, where French also avoids "digne", which would turn the point into one of merit.

decisions.choice: "자격" for fit, as in 2 Corinthians 2:16 and 3:5-6
decisions.reason: The word is the one the project keeps for being fit or sufficient through both letters; Korean uses "자격" (qualification) at each place.

decisions.choice: a Igreja de Deus
decisions.reason: Style section 6: Paul persecuted believers wherever they were (Galatians 1:13), not one congregation, so "Igreja" takes the capital used for the whole body of believers. "A igreja de Deus que está em Corinto" (1:2) is lowercase.

decisions.choice: apto (L); estar à altura (B)
decisions.reason: "Digno" (worthy) is the familiar word here, but the Greek word means fit or qualified (m2), not deserving; "apto" and "estar à altura" keep that sense and the link with 2 Corinthians 2:16; 3:5-6.

decisions.choice: не гідний
decisions.reason: The Corinthians note keeps "sufficient, fit" for hikanos in 2 Corinthians; here the sense is plain fitness for a name (m2), and Ukrainian "гідний" says that.

source.text: χάριτι δὲ θεοῦ εἰμι ὅ εἰμι, καὶ ἡ χάρις αὐτοῦ ἡ εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ κενὴ ἐγενήθη, ἀλλὰ περισσότερον αὐτῶν πάντων ἐκοπίασα, οὐκ ἐγὼ δὲ ἀλλὰ ἡ χάρις τοῦ θεοῦ ἡ σὺν ἐμοί.

records.literal_gloss: by grace but of God I am what I am, and the grace of him that toward me not empty became, but more than them all I labored, not I but but the grace of the God that [is] with me.

en.L: But by [the] grace of God I am what I am, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace toward me did not turn out empty; rather, I toiled more than all of them, yet not I, but the grace of God that [is] with me.
en.B: It is God's grace that has made me what I am, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace to me was not wasted. Instead, I have toiled harder than all of them, though it was not I but God's grace working with me.
en.R: But God in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace made me what I am, and that grace was not wasted on me. In fact, I have worked harder than all the other apostles. Yet it was not really I who did it. It was God's grace, which was with me.

fr.L: Mais par la grâce de Dieu je suis ce que je suis, et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce envers moi n’a pas été vaine ; au contraire, j’ai peiné plus qu’eux tous, non pas moi toutefois, mais la grâce de Dieu qui [est] avec moi.
fr.B: C’est la grâce de Dieu qui a fait de moi ce que je suis, et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce envers moi n’a pas été perdue. Au contraire, je me suis donné plus de peine qu’eux tous, ou plutôt non pas moi, mais la grâce de Dieu qui agit avec moi.
fr.R: Mais Dieu, dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, a fait de moi ce que je suis, et cette grâce n’a pas été gaspillée. En fait, j’ai travaillé plus dur que tous les autres apôtres. Pourtant, ce n’est pas vraiment moi qui l’ai fait. C’est la grâce de Dieu, qui était avec moi.

es.L: Pero por [la] gracia de Dios soy lo que soy, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia para conmigo no resultó vacía; antes bien, he trabajado más que todos ellos, aunque no yo, sino la gracia de Dios que [está] conmigo.
es.B: Es la gracia de Dios la que me ha hecho lo que soy, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia para conmigo no fue en vano. Al contrario, he trabajado más duro que todos ellos, aunque no fui yo, sino la gracia de Dios que actuaba conmigo.
es.R: Pero Dios, por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, me hizo lo que soy, y esa gracia no se desperdició en mí. De hecho, he trabajado más duro que todos los demás apóstoles. Pero en realidad no lo hice yo. Fue la gracia de Dios, que estaba conmigo.

sw.L: Lakini kwa neema ya Mungu mimi ni hivi nilivyo, na neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwangu haikuwa bure; bali nilifanya kazi kwa bidii kuliko wote hao, lakini si mimi, bali neema ya Mungu [iliyo] pamoja nami.
sw.B: Ni neema ya Mungu iliyonifanya kuwa hivi nilivyo, na neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwangu haikupotea bure. Badala yake, nimefanya kazi kwa bidii kuliko wote hao, ingawa si mimi, bali ni neema ya Mungu iliyofanya kazi pamoja nami.
sw.R: Lakini Mungu kwa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} amenifanya kuwa hivi nilivyo, na neema hiyo haikupotea bure kwangu. Kwa kweli, nimefanya kazi kwa bidii kuliko mitume wengine wote. Lakini si mimi hasa niliyefanya hivyo. Ilikuwa neema ya Mungu, iliyokuwa pamoja nami.

vi.L: Nhưng bởi ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời, tôi là người như tôi hiện nay, và ân điển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đối với tôi đã không trở nên trống rỗng; trái lại, tôi đã làm việc khó nhọc hơn tất cả họ, nhưng không phải tôi, mà là ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời ở cùng tôi.
vi.B: Chính ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho tôi được như ngày nay, và ân điển {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho tôi đã không uổng phí. Trái lại, tôi đã làm việc khó nhọc hơn tất cả các sứ đồ kia, dù thật ra không phải tôi, nhưng là ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời cùng làm việc với tôi.
vi.R: Nhưng bởi ân điển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho tôi được như hiện nay, và ân điển ấy đã không uổng phí nơi tôi. Thật vậy, tôi đã làm việc vất vả hơn tất cả các sứ đồ khác. Nhưng thật ra không phải tôi đã làm điều đó. Đó là ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời ở cùng tôi.

ko.L: 그러나 하나님의 은혜로 내가 지금의 내가 되었습니다. 나에게 주신 그분의 은혜는 헛되지 않았습니다. 오히려 나는 그들 모두보다 더 많이 수고했습니다. 그러나 [그것은] 내가 아니라 나와 함께 있는 하나님의 은혜였습니다.
ko.B: 지금의 내가 있는 것은 하나님의 은혜 덕분입니다. 나에게 베푸신 그분의 은혜는 헛되지 않았습니다. 오히려 나는 그들 모두보다 더 열심히 수고했습니다. 그러나 그것은 내가 한 것이 아니라 나와 함께 일하는 하나님의 은혜가 한 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러나 하나님께서 은혜를 베푸셔서 나를 지금의 나로 만드셨습니다. 그 은혜는 나에게 헛되지 않았습니다. 사실 나는 다른 모든 사도보다 더 열심히 일했습니다. 그러나 정말로 그 일을 한 것은 내가 아니었습니다. 나와 함께하신 하나님의 은혜였습니다.

pt.L: Mas pela graça de Deus sou o que sou, e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça para comigo não se tornou vazia; antes, trabalhei mais do que todos eles, contudo não eu, mas a graça de Deus que [está] comigo.
pt.B: É a graça de Deus que me fez o que sou, e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça para comigo não foi desperdiçada. Pelo contrário, trabalhei mais do que todos eles, embora não fosse eu, mas a graça de Deus que agia comigo.
pt.R: Mas Deus, na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça, me fez o que eu sou, e essa graça não foi desperdiçada em mim. Na verdade, eu trabalhei mais do que todos os outros apóstolos. Mas, de fato, não fui eu quem fez isso. Foi a graça de Deus, que estava comigo.

am.L: ነገር ግን የሆንኩትን የሆንኩት በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ነው፤ በእኔ ላይ የሆነው ጸጋውም ከንቱ ሆኖ አልቀረም፤ ይልቁንም ከሁሉም አብልጬ ደከምኩ፤ ይህም እኔ አይደለሁም፣ ከእኔ ጋር ያለው የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ነው እንጂ።
am.B: አሁን ያለሁትን ያደረገኝ የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ነው፤ ለእኔ የሰጠኝም ጸጋ በከንቱ አልባከነም። ይልቁንም ከሁሉም ይበልጥ በትጋት ሠርቻለሁ፤ ይህን ያደረገው ግን እኔ ሳልሆን ከእኔ ጋር የሚሠራው የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ነው።
am.R: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር በጸጋው አሁን ያለሁትን አደረገኝ፤ ያም ጸጋ በእኔ ላይ በከንቱ አልባከነም። እንዲያውም ከሌሎቹ ሐዋርያት ሁሉ የበለጠ ሠርቻለሁ። ይህን ያደረግኩት ግን በእርግጥ እኔ አይደለሁም። ከእኔ ጋር የነበረው የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ነው።

hi.L: पर परमेश्वर के अनुग्रह से मैं जो हूँ सो हूँ, और उनका अनुग्रह जो मुझ पर हुआ, वह व्यर्थ नहीं ठहरा; बल्कि मैंने उन सब से बढ़कर परिश्रम किया, तौभी मैंने नहीं, पर परमेश्वर के अनुग्रह ने जो मेरे साथ [है]।
hi.B: परमेश्वर के अनुग्रह ने ही मुझे वह बनाया जो मैं हूँ, और उनका अनुग्रह जो मुझ पर हुआ, व्यर्थ नहीं गया। इसके विपरीत, मैंने उन सब से अधिक परिश्रम किया है, यद्यपि वह मैं नहीं, पर परमेश्वर का अनुग्रह था जो मेरे साथ काम कर रहा था।
hi.R: पर परमेश्वर ने अपने अनुग्रह से मुझे वह बनाया जो मैं हूँ, और वह अनुग्रह मुझ पर व्यर्थ नहीं गया। सच तो यह है कि मैंने दूसरे सब प्रेरितों से ज़्यादा मेहनत की है। फिर भी असल में वह मैं नहीं था जिसने यह किया। वह परमेश्वर का अनुग्रह था, जो मेरे साथ था।

ru.L: Но благодатью Бога я то, что я есть, и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} благодать ко мне не оказалась тщетной, но я потрудился больше всех их, — не я же, а благодать Божья, которая [со] мной.
ru.B: Это Божья благодать сделала меня тем, кто я есть, и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} благодать ко мне не пропала даром. Напротив, я трудился больше их всех, хотя не я, а Божья благодать, действующая со мной.
ru.R: Но Бог по своей благодати сделал меня тем, кто я есть, и эта благодать не пропала во мне даром. Я трудился больше всех других апостолов. Но на самом деле это делал не я. Это делала Божья благодать, которая была со мной.

uk.L: Але благодаттю Божою я є те, що я є, і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} благодать до мене не була марною, а я працював більше за всіх них, та не я, а благодать Божа, що зі мною.
uk.B: Це Божа благодать зробила мене тим, ким я є, і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} благодать до мене не пропала марно. Навпаки, я трудився більше за всіх них, хоча не я, а Божа благодать, яка діяла зі мною.
uk.R: Але Бог зі своєї благодаті зробив мене тим, ким я є, і ця благодать не була змарнована на мені. Насправді я працював більше за всіх інших апостолів. Але це робив не я сам. Це була Божа благодать, яка була зі мною.

ja.L: しかし、神の恵みによって、わたしは今のわたしになっているのです。そして、わたしに対する神の恵みはむなしくはなりませんでした。むしろ、わたしは彼ら全員よりも多く労苦しました。しかし、わたしではなく、わたしに伴っている神の恵みが[労苦したのです]。
ja.B: わたしが今のようなわたしであるのは、神の恵みによるのです。そして、わたしへの神の恵みはむだになりませんでした。それどころか、わたしは彼らのだれよりも懸命に働きました。もっとも、それはわたしではなく、わたしと一緒に働く神の恵みによるのです。
ja.R: でも、神は恵みによって、今のわたしにしてくださいました。そして、その恵みは、わたしにとってむだにはなりませんでした。実際、わたしはほかの使徒たちのだれよりも熱心に働いてきました。でも、本当にそうしたのは、わたしではありません。わたしと共にあった神の恵みが、そうしたのです。

decisions.choice: grace: God's undeserved favor, and the power at work in Paul
decisions.reason: χάριτι, χάρις and χάρις are the same word three times. Set against verse 9, it is favor Paul did nothing to earn. By the third time it is something active: the grace "with" him does the work.

decisions.choice: empty: without result
decisions.reason: κενὴ is the word Paul uses in verse 14 for preaching and faith that would be empty if Christ were not raised, and in verse 58 for work that is not in vain.

decisions.choice: more than all of them: either more than any one apostle or more than all of them together
decisions.reason: περισσότερον αὐτῶν πάντων can be read either way; the translation keeps both open.

decisions.choice: not I but grace: Paul does not deny his own effort, but gives the credit for it to God
decisions.reason: He has just said that he toiled. He then corrects himself, as in Galatians 2:20 and Philippians 2:12-13: the work was his, and yet it was God's grace working in him.

decisions.choice: God in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace made me what I am
alternatives: by the grace of God I am what I am
decisions.reason: Readable makes God the subject so that the sentence is easy to follow.

decisions.choice: "은혜" three times at every level
decisions.reason: "은혜" is a key term and stays the same at every level, so the three uses of the Greek word can be seen.

decisions.choice: የሆንኩትን የሆንኩት በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ነው (what I am, I am by God's grace)
decisions.reason: Amharic cannot end on "I am what I am" after the instrument, so Literal turns the sentence into a cleft that keeps both forms of the verb and puts the stress on grace, where the Greek puts it by placing the word first.

decisions.choice: "अनुग्रह"
decisions.reason: The key term for grace, at every level, kept apart from "कृपा" (kindness), as Romans settled it.

decisions.choice: благодать at every level
decisions.reason: Key term: "благодать" at every level, as the style guide says; Readable uses the reflexive "своєї", which takes no span.

source.text: εἴτε οὖν ἐγὼ εἴτε ἐκεῖνοι, οὕτως κηρύσσομεν καὶ οὕτως ἐπιστεύσατε.

records.literal_gloss: whether then I or those, so we proclaim and so you believed.

en.L: Whether then [it was] I or they, so we proclaim and so you believed.
en.B: In any case, whether it came from me or from them, this is the message we all proclaim, and this is the message you believed.
en.R: So it does not matter whether you heard it from me or from the other apostles. We all preach the same message, and it is this message that you believed.

fr.L: Que ce soit donc moi, que ce soit eux, ainsi nous proclamons et ainsi vous avez cru.
fr.B: Quoi qu’il en soit, que le message vienne de moi ou d’eux, c’est là ce que nous proclamons tous, et c’est là ce que vous avez cru.
fr.R: Peu importe donc que vous l’ayez entendu de moi ou des autres apôtres. Nous annonçons tous le même message, et c’est ce message que vous avez cru.

es.L: Sea, pues, yo o ellos, así predicamos y así {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}.
es.B: En todo caso, sea que venga de mí o de ellos, este es el mensaje que todos predicamos, y este es el mensaje que {{plural_you:ustedes creyeron|vosotros creísteis}}.
es.R: Así que no importa si lo {{plural_you:oyeron|oísteis}} de mí o de los otros apóstoles. Todos predicamos el mismo mensaje, y es este mensaje el que {{plural_you:ustedes creyeron|vosotros creísteis}}.

sw.L: Basi, ikiwa ni mimi au ni wao, ndivyo tunavyohubiri na ndivyo mlivyoamini.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, iwe ujumbe ulitoka kwangu au kwao, huu ndio ujumbe tunaohubiri sote, na huu ndio ujumbe mlioamini.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo haijalishi kama mliusikia kutoka kwangu au kutoka kwa mitume wengine. Sote tunahubiri ujumbe ule ule, na ni ujumbe huu mlioamini.

vi.L: Vậy, dù là tôi hay là họ, chúng tôi rao giảng như vậy và anh chị em đã tin như vậy.
vi.B: Dù sao đi nữa, dù anh chị em nghe từ tôi hay từ họ, đó là sứ điệp tất cả chúng tôi rao giảng, và đó là sứ điệp anh chị em đã tin.
vi.R: Vậy anh chị em nghe sứ điệp ấy từ tôi hay từ các sứ đồ khác cũng không quan trọng. Tất cả chúng tôi đều rao giảng cùng một sứ điệp, và chính sứ điệp ấy là điều anh chị em đã tin.

ko.L: 그러니 나든지 그들이든지, 우리는 이렇게 전파하고 여러분은 이렇게 믿었습니다.
ko.B: 그러니 그것이 나에게서 왔든 그들에게서 왔든, 우리가 모두 전파하는 것은 이 말씀이고, 여러분이 믿은 것도 이 말씀입니다.
ko.R: 그러니 여러분이 그 소식을 나에게서 들었든 다른 사도들에게서 들었든 상관없습니다. 우리는 모두 같은 소식을 전하고, 여러분이 믿은 것도 바로 이 소식입니다.

pt.L: Seja, pois, eu, sejam eles, assim proclamamos e assim vocês creram.
pt.B: Seja como for, quer a mensagem tenha vindo de mim, quer deles, é isto que todos nós proclamamos, e foi nisto que vocês creram.
pt.R: Então não importa se vocês ouviram a mensagem de mim ou dos outros apóstolos. Todos nós pregamos a mesma mensagem, e foi nessa mensagem que vocês acreditaram.

am.L: እንግዲህ እኔም ሆንኩ እነርሱ፣ እንዲሁ እንሰብካለን፤ እናንተም እንዲሁ አመናችሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ከእኔ ይምጣ ወይም ከእነርሱ፣ ሁላችንም የምንሰብከው ይህንኑ መልእክት ነው፤ እናንተም ያመናችሁት ይህንኑ መልእክት ነው።
am.R: ስለዚህ መልእክቱን የሰማችሁት ከእኔ ይሁን ወይም ከሌሎቹ ሐዋርያት ልዩነት የለውም። ሁላችንም የምንሰብከው አንድ መልእክት ነው፤ እናንተም ያመናችሁት ይህንኑ መልእክት ነው።

hi.L: इसलिए चाहे मैं, चाहे वे, हम ऐसे ही प्रचार करते हैं, और तुमने ऐसे ही विश्वास किया।
hi.B: जो भी हो, चाहे यह मुझसे आया या उनसे, हम सब यही संदेश सुनाते हैं, और इसी संदेश पर तुमने विश्वास किया।
hi.R: इसलिए इससे कोई फ़र्क़ नहीं पड़ता कि तुमने यह मुझसे सुना या दूसरे प्रेरितों से। हम सब एक ही संदेश सुनाते हैं, और इसी संदेश पर तुमने विश्वास किया।

ru.L: Итак, я ли, они ли, — так мы проповедуем, и так вы уверовали.
ru.B: Как бы то ни было, от меня ли, от них ли, — вот что мы все проповедуем, и вот во что вы уверовали.
ru.R: Поэтому неважно, от кого вы услышали эту весть, от меня или от других апостолов. Мы все проповедуем одну и ту же весть, и именно в неё вы поверили.

uk.L: Тож чи я, чи вони, так ми проповідуємо, і так ви повірили.
uk.B: Хай там як, від мене чи від них, — це та звістка, яку ми всі проповідуємо, і це та звістка, у яку ви повірили.
uk.R: Тож неважливо, чи ви почули її від мене, чи від інших апостолів. Ми всі проповідуємо ту саму звістку, і саме в цю звістку ви повірили.

ja.L: ですから、わたしであれ、あの人たちであれ、このようにわたしたちは宣べ伝え、このようにあなたがたは信じたのです。
ja.B: いずれにしても、わたしからであれ、あの人たちからであれ、これがわたしたち皆の宣べ伝えている知らせであり、あなたがたが信じた知らせなのです。
ja.R: ですから、みなさんがその知らせを、わたしから聞いたか、ほかの使徒たちから聞いたかは、問題ではありません。わたしたちはみな、同じ知らせを伝えています。そして、みなさんが信じたのは、この知らせなのです。

decisions.choice: they: the other apostles and witnesses just named
decisions.reason: ἐκεῖνοι looks back to Cephas, the Twelve, James and the apostles in verses 5-7.

decisions.choice: so: this same message, the one set out in verses 3-5
