fr.B: Après cela viendra la fin, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} remettra le royaume à Dieu le Père, après avoir mis fin à toute principauté, à toute autorité et à toute puissance. \v 25 Car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} règne doit durer jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ait placé tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.
fr.R: Ensuite, la fin viendra. Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} remettra le royaume à Dieu le Père, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aura mis fin à tous les chefs, à toutes les autorités et à toutes les puissances qui s’opposent à Dieu. \v 25 Car le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} doit régner comme roi jusqu’à ce que tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis aient été mis sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.

es.L: Luego [vendrá] el fin, cuando entregue el reino a Dios, el Padre, cuando haya destruido todo dominio y toda autoridad y poder. \v 25 Porque es necesario que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} reine hasta que haya puesto a todos los enemigos debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.
es.B: Después vendrá el fin, cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} entregue el reino a Dios el Padre, una vez que haya puesto fin a todo gobernante, a toda autoridad y a todo poder. \v 25 Porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reinado debe continuar hasta que haya puesto a todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.
es.R: Entonces llegará el fin. {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} entregará el reino a Dios el Padre, cuando haya puesto fin a todo gobernante, a toda autoridad y a todo poder que se opone a Dios. \v 25 Porque {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} tiene que reinar hasta que todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos hayan sido puestos debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.

sw.L: Kisha [unakuja] mwisho, atakapomkabidhi Mungu, yaani Baba, ufalme, atakapokuwa amebatilisha kila utawala na kila mamlaka na nguvu. \v 25 Kwa maana ni lazima {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atawale mpaka atakapowaweka maadui wote chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Baadaye unakuja mwisho, atakapomkabidhi Mungu Baba ufalme, baada ya kukomesha kila mtawala, kila mamlaka na kila nguvu. \v 25 Kwa maana utawala {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} lazima uendelee mpaka atakapowaweka maadui {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Kisha mwisho utakuja. {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} atampa Mungu Baba ufalme, baada ya kukomesha kila mtawala, kila mamlaka na kila nguvu inayompinga Mungu. \v 25 Kwa maana {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} lazima atawale kama mfalme mpaka maadui {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote watakapowekwa chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Rồi đến sự cuối cùng, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giao vương quốc lại cho Đức Chúa Trời là Cha, sau khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tiêu diệt mọi bậc cai trị, mọi thế lực và quyền năng. \v 25 Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải cai trị cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt mọi kẻ thù dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Sau đó là sự cuối cùng, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giao vương quốc lại cho Đức Chúa Trời là Cha, một khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chấm dứt mọi bậc cai trị, mọi thế lực và mọi quyền năng. \v 25 Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải tiếp tục cai trị cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt mọi kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Rồi sự cuối cùng sẽ đến. {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} sẽ giao vương quốc lại cho Đức Chúa Trời là Cha, sau khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chấm dứt mọi kẻ cai trị, mọi thế lực và mọi quyền năng chống nghịch Đức Chúa Trời. \v 25 Vì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} phải cai trị như vua cho đến khi mọi kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều bị đặt dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그다음에 마지막이 [옵니다]. 그분이 모든 통치와 모든 권세와 능력을 없애시고, 나라를 하나님 아버지께 넘겨 드리실 때입니다. \v 25 그분은 모든 원수를 자기 발아래 두실 때까지 다스리셔야 하기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그다음에는 마지막이 옵니다. 그때 그분은 모든 통치자와 모든 권세와 모든 능력을 없애시고, 나라를 하나님 아버지께 넘겨 드리실 것입니다. \v 25 그분은 모든 원수를 그분의 발아래 두실 때까지 다스리셔야 합니다.
ko.R: 그다음에 마지막이 올 것입니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 하나님을 대적하는 모든 통치자와 모든 권세와 모든 능력을 없애실 것입니다. 그리고 그 나라를 하나님 아버지께 넘겨 드리실 것입니다. \v 25 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 모든 원수가 그분의 발아래 놓일 때까지 왕으로 다스리셔야 합니다.

pt.L: Então [vem] o fim, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} entregar o Reino ao Deus e Pai, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tiver anulado todo domínio e toda autoridade e poder. \v 25 Pois é necessário que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} reine até que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tenha posto todos os inimigos debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés.
pt.B: Depois vem o fim, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} entregar o Reino a Deus, o Pai, depois de ter posto fim a todo governante, toda autoridade e todo poder. \v 25 Pois o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} reinado precisa continuar até que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tenha colocado todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} inimigos debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés.
pt.R: Então virá o fim. {{christos:Cristo|O Messias}} vai entregar o Reino a Deus, o Pai, depois de acabar com todo governante, toda autoridade e todo poder que se opõe a Deus. \v 25 Pois {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} precisa reinar até que todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} inimigos tenham sido postos debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés.

am.L: ከዚያም መጨረሻው [ይሆናል]፤ ይኸውም መንግሥቱን ለእግዚአብሔር፣ ለአብ፣ አሳልፎ በሚሰጥበት ጊዜ፣ አገዛዝን ሁሉ፣ ሥልጣንን ሁሉና ኃይልንም በሻረ ጊዜ ነው። \v 25 ጠላቶቹን ሁሉ ከእግሩ በታች እስኪያደርግ ድረስ ሊነግሥ ይገባዋልና።
am.B: ከዚያም መጨረሻው ይመጣል፤ ይህም ገዢን ሁሉ፣ ሥልጣንን ሁሉና ኃይልን ሁሉ አጥፍቶ መንግሥቱን ለእግዚአብሔር አብ በሚሰጥበት ጊዜ ነው። \v 25 ጠላቶቹን ሁሉ ከእግሩ በታች እስኪያደርግ ድረስ ንግሥናው መቀጠል አለበትና።
am.R: ከዚያም መጨረሻው ይመጣል። {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} እግዚአብሔርን የሚቃወሙትን ገዢዎች ሁሉ፣ ባለ ሥልጣናትን ሁሉና ኃይላትን ሁሉ ካጠፋ በኋላ መንግሥቱን ለእግዚአብሔር አብ ይሰጣል። \v 25 ጠላቶቹ ሁሉ ከእግሩ በታች እስኪደረጉ ድረስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} እንደ ንጉሥ ሊገዛ ይገባዋልና።

hi.L: फिर अंत [आएगा], जब वे राज्य को परमेश्वर, अर्थात् पिता, के हाथ सौंप देंगे, जब वे सारी प्रधानता और सारे अधिकार और सामर्थ्य का अंत कर देंगे। \v 25 क्योंकि जब तक वे सब शत्रुओं को अपने पाँवों तले न कर दें, तब तक उनका राज्य करना अवश्य है।
hi.B: उसके बाद अंत आएगा, जब वे राज्य को पिता परमेश्वर के हाथ सौंप देंगे, जब वे हर शासक, हर अधिकार और हर शक्ति का अंत कर चुके होंगे। \v 25 क्योंकि उनका राज्य तब तक चलना अवश्य है जब तक वे अपने सब शत्रुओं को अपने पाँवों तले न कर दें।
hi.R: तब अंत आएगा। मसीह राज्य को पिता परमेश्वर के हाथ सौंप देंगे, जब वे हर उस शासक, हर अधिकार और हर शक्ति का अंत कर चुके होंगे जो परमेश्वर का विरोध करती है। \v 25 क्योंकि मसीह को तब तक राजा होकर राज्य करना है जब तक उनके सब शत्रु उनके पाँवों तले न कर दिए जाएँ।

ru.L: Затем — конец, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} передаст Царство Богу и Отцу, когда упразднит всякое начальство и всякую власть и силу. \v 25 Ведь {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} надлежит царствовать, пока {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не положит всех врагов под свои ноги.
ru.B: Потом наступит конец, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} передаст Царство Богу Отцу, после того как положит конец всякому правителю, всякой власти и всякой силе. \v 25 Ведь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} царствование должно продолжаться, пока {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не положит всех врагов под свои ноги.
ru.R: Потом наступит конец. {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} передаст Царство Богу Отцу, после того как положит конец всякому правителю, всякой власти и всякой силе, которые противятся Богу. \v 25 Ведь {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} должен царствовать, пока все {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} враги не будут положены под {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ноги.

uk.L: Потім — кінець, коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} передасть Царство Богові й Отцеві, коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} знищить усяке начальство, і всяку владу, і силу. \v 25 Бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} мусить царювати, доки не покладе всіх ворогів під {{deity_pronoun:свої|Свої}} ноги.
uk.B: Після того настане кінець, коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} передасть Царство Богові Отцю, покінчивши з кожним правителем, кожною владою і кожною силою. \v 25 Бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} царювання мусить тривати, доки {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} не покладе всіх {{deity_pronoun:своїх|Своїх}} ворогів під {{deity_pronoun:свої|Свої}} ноги.
uk.R: Тоді настане кінець. {{christos:Христос|Месія}} віддасть Царство Богові Отцю, коли покінчить з кожним правителем, кожною владою і кожною силою, які противляться Богові. \v 25 Бо {{christos:Христос|Месія}} мусить царювати, доки всі {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} вороги не будуть покладені під {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ноги.

ja.L: それから終わりが[来ます]。[{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}が]国を父である神に引き渡されるときです。それは、すべての支配、すべての権威と勢力を滅ぼされるときです。\v 25 というのは、すべての敵をその足の下に置かれるまで、[{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は]王として治めなければならないからです。
ja.B: それから終わりが来ます。そのとき、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}はすべての支配者、すべての権威、すべての力を滅ぼして、国を父である神にお渡しになります。\v 25 {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は、すべての敵をご自分の足の下に置かれるまで、王として治めることになっているからです。
ja.R: それから、終わりが来ます。{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は、神に逆らうすべての支配者、すべての権威、すべての力を滅ぼされたあと、国を父である神にお渡しになります。\v 25 {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は、すべての敵がその足の下に置かれるまで、王として治めなければならないからです。

decisions.choice: he hands over, he does away with, he must reign: Christ
decisions.reason: Christ is the subject from verse 23, and he hands the kingdom to God the Father.

decisions.choice: until he has put: most naturally Christ, continuing the subject; under his feet: Christ's
alternatives: God puts the enemies under Christ's feet, as in Psalm 110:1, where God speaks to the king
decisions.reason: The subject of θῇ is not stated. The run of the sentence points to Christ; the Psalm and verse 27, where God subjects all things to Christ, point to God. Either way the enemies end up under Christ's feet.

decisions.choice: Psalm 110:1
decisions.reason: In Psalm 110:1 the LORD (the divine name in the Hebrew) says to the king, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet." Paul alludes to it in his own words, and joins the phrase "under his feet" from Psalm 8:7, which he quotes in verse 27.

decisions.choice: rule, authority, power: the powers, seen and unseen, that oppose God
decisions.reason: The same words name hostile powers in 2:6-8, Ephesians 1:21 and Colossians 2:15. Here they are among the "enemies" of verse 25.

decisions.choice: hands over the kingdom: when every enemy is defeated, the Son gives the kingdom to the Father, and his work of subduing reaches its goal
decisions.reason: Paul describes the end of Christ's work of conquering, not a loss of his honor. Verse 28 says more about the Son's place; Philippians 2:9-11 likewise ends Christ's exaltation in the glory of God the Father.

decisions.choice: the end: the close of the present age
alternatives: the rest, the remaining people to be raised
decisions.reason: τέλος can mean "the rest", which would continue the list of verse 23, but its usual sense in Paul is the end (1:8; 10:11), and what follows describes the end of all things.

decisions.choice: put an end to
decisions.reason: The verb means to make powerless or do away with; Literal says "done away with", as in 2 Corinthians 3.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}}; that opposes God; have been put under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet
decisions.reason: Readable names Christ, says that these powers are hostile (m4), and uses a passive so as not to decide who puts the enemies under his feet (m2).

decisions.choice: principauté, autorité, puissance (L, B); les chefs, les autorités, les puissances (R)
decisions.reason: The same names as in Colossians 1:16 and 2:10, 15 for the powers, seen and unseen, that oppose God (m4); Readable says "chefs", a plain word, as there.

decisions.choice: abolir (L); mettre fin à (B, R); in 15:26 aboli (L, B), détruit (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to make powerless or do away with. "Abolir" says that something ceases to have force; "anéantir" would add the picture of destruction, which only Readable uses for death, as the English does.

decisions.choice: destruir (L); poner fin a (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to do away with, to bring to nothing; Literal "destruir" and Balanced and Readable "poner fin a" say that the powers are defeated, as the English does. Verse 26 keeps "destruir".

decisions.choice: amebatilisha (L); kukomesha (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal "kubatilisha" (make void, strip of power) for the verb the English Literal renders "do away with"; Balanced and Readable "kukomesha" (put an end to), as the English "put an end to". The same pair for death in verse 26.

decisions.choice: utawala, mamlaka, nguvu (L); mtawala, mamlaka, nguvu (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Mamlaka" is the settled word for this Greek word (authority); the three name the powers, seen and unseen, that oppose God (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "mọi bậc cai trị, mọi thế lực và quyền năng" (L, B)
alternatives: "mọi quyền cai trị, thẩm quyền và sức mạnh"
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Ephesians 1:21 and Colossians 1:16 for the powers that oppose God (m4).

decisions.choice: "넘겨 드리다", with the humble "드리다" for the Son giving the kingdom to the Father
decisions.reason: Korean shows respect to the one receiving with "드리다"; the Son hands the kingdom to God the Father, so Korean says "넘겨 드리시다", with the honorific for the Son and the humble form toward the Father.

decisions.choice: "통치, 권세, 능력" (L); "통치자, 권세, 능력" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of Colossians 1:16 and Romans 8:38 (Korean) for the powers.

decisions.choice: Literal puts the "doing away" clause before the "handing over" clause
alternatives: the Greek order, handing over first
decisions.reason: Korean puts the two "when" clauses before the noun they describe ("... 때입니다"); with the handing over last, the order of events is clear, as the English Balanced makes it ("once he has put an end").

decisions.choice: anular (L); pôr fim a (B); acabar com (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to make powerless or do away with. "Anular" (L) keeps that sense and can be used again for 2 Corinthians 3; "destruir" is kept for Readable in verse 26, where the English Readable says "destroyed".

decisions.choice: ሻረ (did away with) at Literal; አጠፋ (put an end to) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: "ሻረ" (abolish, annul) keeps the sense of making something powerless that runs through Paul's word; Balanced and Readable say plainly that the powers are ended, as the English does. Verse 26 follows the same split.

decisions.choice: "अंत कर देना"
decisions.reason: The verb means to make powerless and do away with, the same verb as 13:8-11; Hindi "अंत कर देना" says that it ends their power.

decisions.choice: под свои ноги (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: With Christ as the subject Russian uses the reflexive "свои", which takes no span; Readable, with a passive, writes "{{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}" as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:свої|Свої}}, {{deity_pronoun:своїх|Своїх}} for "his feet", "his enemies"
decisions.reason: The style guide exempts the reflexive "свій", but here Christ is the subject and the English puts the span on "his"; keeping it lets the reader's setting reach these words. A reviewer may prefer the plain reflexive.

decisions.choice: начальство, влада, сила
decisions.reason: The three words for the powers that oppose God (m4); "начальство" keeps the Greek archē as the ruling powers, as Ephesians does.

decisions.choice: "[キリストが]" (L) and "キリストは" (B), each in a christos span, name the subject
decisions.reason: The subject of hands over, does away with and must reign is Christ (m1, m2); Japanese does not use "彼" for him, so the name is supplied.

source.text: ἔσχατος ἐχθρὸς καταργεῖται ὁ θάνατος, πάντα γὰρ ὑπέταξεν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: last enemy is being done away with, the death; \v 27 all things for he subjected under the feet of him.

en.L: [The] last enemy is being done away with: death. \v 27 For "{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} subjected all things under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet."
en.B: The last enemy to be done away with is death. \v 27 For "{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has placed everything in subjection beneath {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet."
en.R: The last enemy that will be destroyed is death. \v 27 For Scripture says that God has put everything under the feet of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

fr.L: Le dernier ennemi est aboli : la mort. \v 27 Car « Il a soumis toutes choses sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds. »
fr.B: Le dernier ennemi qui sera aboli, c’est la mort. \v 27 Car « Il a tout placé sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds. »
fr.R: Le dernier ennemi qui sera détruit, c’est la mort. \v 27 Car l’Écriture dit que Dieu a tout mis sous les pieds du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

es.L: [El] último enemigo que es destruido es la muerte. \v 27 Porque «todo lo sometió debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies».
es.B: El último enemigo que será destruido es la muerte. \v 27 Porque «todo lo ha puesto en sujeción debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies».
es.R: El último enemigo que será destruido es la muerte. \v 27 Porque la Escritura dice que Dios ha puesto todo bajo los pies {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.

sw.L: Adui wa mwisho anabatilishwa: kifo. \v 27 Kwa maana "Alivitiisha vitu vyote chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."
sw.B: Adui wa mwisho atakayekomeshwa ni kifo. \v 27 Kwa maana "Amevitiisha vitu vyote chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."
sw.R: Adui wa mwisho atakayeangamizwa ni kifo. \v 27 Kwa maana Maandiko yanasema kwamba Mungu ameweka kila kitu chini ya miguu ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

vi.L: Kẻ thù cuối cùng bị tiêu diệt là sự chết. \v 27 Vì "{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt mọi sự phục dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Kẻ thù cuối cùng sẽ bị tiêu diệt là sự chết. \v 27 Vì "{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt mọi vật phục dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.R: Kẻ thù cuối cùng sẽ bị tiêu diệt là sự chết. \v 27 Vì Kinh Thánh nói rằng Đức Chúa Trời đã đặt mọi vật dưới chân {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.

ko.L: 마지막 원수로 죽음이 없어지고 있습니다. \v 27 "그분이 모든 것을 그의 발아래 복종하게 하셨다" [하였기 때문입니다].
ko.B: 마지막으로 없어질 원수는 죽음입니다. \v 27 "하나님께서 모든 것을 그의 발아래 복종하게 하셨다" 했기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 마지막으로 멸망할 원수는 죽음입니다. \v 27 성경은 하나님께서 모든 것을 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 발아래 두셨다고 말합니다.

pt.L: [O] último inimigo está sendo anulado: a morte. \v 27 Pois "{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} sujeitou todas as coisas debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés."
pt.B: O último inimigo a ser eliminado é a morte. \v 27 Pois "{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pôs todas as coisas em sujeição debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés."
pt.R: O último inimigo que será destruído é a morte. \v 27 Pois as Escrituras dizem que Deus pôs tudo debaixo dos pés {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}.

am.L: የመጨረሻው ጠላት ይሻራል፤ [እርሱም] ሞት [ነው]። \v 27 ምክንያቱም «ሁሉን ከእግሩ በታች አስገዛ።»
am.B: የሚሻረው የመጨረሻው ጠላት ሞት ነው። \v 27 ምክንያቱም «ሁሉን ነገር ከእግሩ በታች አስገዛለት።»
am.R: የሚጠፋው የመጨረሻው ጠላት ሞት ነው። \v 27 መጽሐፍ እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ነገር {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} እግር በታች እንዳደረገ ይናገራልና።

hi.L: सबसे अंतिम शत्रु जिसका अंत किया जा रहा है, मृत्यु है। \v 27 क्योंकि "उन्होंने सब कुछ उनके पाँवों तले कर दिया।"
hi.B: जिस अंतिम शत्रु का अंत किया जाएगा, वह मृत्यु है। \v 27 क्योंकि "उन्होंने सब कुछ उनके पाँवों तले अधीन कर दिया है।"
hi.R: जो अंतिम शत्रु नष्ट किया जाएगा, वह मृत्यु है। \v 27 क्योंकि पवित्रशास्त्र कहता है कि परमेश्वर ने सब कुछ मसीह के पाँवों तले कर दिया है।

ru.L: Последний враг упраздняется — смерть. \v 27 Ведь «всё {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} подчинил под {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ноги.»
ru.B: Последний враг, который будет упразднён, — это смерть. \v 27 Ведь «{{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} всё положил под {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ноги.»
ru.R: Последний враг, который будет уничтожен, — это смерть. \v 27 Ведь Писание говорит, что Бог положил всё под ноги {{christos:Христу|Мессии}}.

uk.L: Останній ворог, що знищується, — смерть. \v 27 Бо «{{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} усе підкорив під {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ноги».
uk.B: Останній ворог, якого буде знищено, — смерть. \v 27 Бо «{{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} усе підкорив під {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ноги».
uk.R: Останній ворог, якого буде знищено, — смерть. \v 27 Бо Писання каже, що Бог поклав усе під ноги {{christos:Христа|Месії}}.

ja.L: 最後の敵として滅ぼされつつあるのは、死です。\v 27 というのは、「[神は]すべてのものをその足の下に従わせた」からです。
ja.B: 最後に滅ぼされる敵は、死です。\v 27 「神はすべてのものを、その足の下に従わせた」とあるからです。
ja.R: 最後に滅ぼされる敵は、死です。\v 27 聖書には、神がすべてのものを{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の足の下に置かれたと書かれているからです。

decisions.choice: is being done away with: certain to happen, and already set in motion by Christ's resurrection
alternatives: simply future, will be done away with
decisions.reason: καταργεῖται is present tense. It can state a certain future as if already happening; the work has begun, since Christ has been raised.

decisions.choice: death, the last enemy: death is spoken of as a hostile power, the last to be defeated
decisions.reason: Death came through Adam (verse 21) and rules over all people (Romans 5:14, 17). Its defeat is the resurrection itself (verses 54-55).

decisions.choice: Psalm 8:7
decisions.reason: The Psalm says of humankind that God has "put all things under his feet". Paul applies it to Christ, the human being through whom the rule given to humankind is fulfilled (verse 21; compare Ephesians 1:22; Hebrews 2:6-9). He changes "you" to "he".

decisions.choice: he subjected: God, the one addressed in the Psalm; under his feet: Christ's
alternatives: Christ put all things under his own feet
decisions.reason: In the Psalm, God is the one who subjects all things. Verses 27-28 confirm it: God is "the one who subjected all things to him".

decisions.choice: Scripture says that God has put everything under the feet of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}
alternatives: For "{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} subjected all things under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet"
decisions.reason: Readable says that this is a quotation and names God and Christ (m3, m4).

decisions.choice: « Il a soumis ... » with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English puts the span on "he" at the start of the quotation. In French a pronoun that begins a sentence is written plainly with its capital (style guide 7); "ses pieds" keeps the span.

decisions.choice: someter, sujeción (verses 27-28)
decisions.reason: The verb means to put under, to subject (m4); Literal says "someter" and Balanced "poner en sujeción", and both keep the same verb through verses 27-28 so the reader can follow who is subjected to whom. Readable says "poner bajo".

decisions.choice: kutiisha, kutiishwa
decisions.reason: "Kutiisha" (bring under, make subject) and its passive carry the one Greek verb through verses 27-28, as the English "subject" does; Readable says "kuweka chini" (put under), as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: "bị tiêu diệt" for katargeitai here, of death (also 15:24 "tiêu diệt", "chấm dứt")
decisions.reason: In chapter 13 this verb is "bãi bỏ" for gifts that end; here it is said of enemies and death, and the English says "done away with", "destroyed", so Vietnamese uses the verb for an enemy overcome.

decisions.choice: the psalm in the plain style, with "그의" for the one under whose feet all things are put, inside the quotation
decisions.reason: As in Romans 10:11 and 15:12, the person spoken of inside a quotation of Scripture takes the plain "그" without the honorific, as the psalm first spoke of humankind; Paul's own sentences keep the honorific for Christ.

decisions.choice: "하나님께서" (B) for "he" in the psalm
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the subject as God, the one addressed in the psalm; Balanced names him, as the English Readable does, so that the "he" and "his" of the quotation are not taken for the same person.

decisions.choice: ምክንያቱም (for) before the quotation
alternatives: the suffix -ና after the quoted verb
decisions.reason: The Greek "for" stands outside the quoted Psalm line; Amharic would attach it to the verb inside the quotation, so it becomes a separate word before the opening mark and the quotation stays whole.

decisions.choice: "उन्होंने ... उनके"
decisions.reason: God is the subject and Christ the one under whose feet all is put (meaning decision m4); both take the honorific, and Readable names them, as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} (God) ... під {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ноги (Christ's)
decisions.reason: m4: God is the one who subjects, and the feet are Christ's; Ukrainian uses "його", not the reflexive, so the two persons stay apart.

decisions.choice: The Psalm quoted in plain style ("従わせた"), with "神は" supplied ([神は] in L)
decisions.reason: Quoted Scripture stays plain (style 4); God is the one who subjects all things, under Christ's feet (m4).

source.text: ὅταν δὲ εἴπῃ ὅτι πάντα ὑποτέτακται, δῆλον ὅτι ἐκτὸς τοῦ ὑποτάξαντος αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα.

records.literal_gloss: when but it says that all things have been subjected, clear that except the [one] having subjected to him the all things.

en.L: But when [it] says, "All things have been subjected," [it is] clear that [this is] apart from the one who subjected all things to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Now when Scripture says that all things have been placed in subjection, it is obvious that this does not include the one who placed all things in subjection to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Scripture says that everything has been put under {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. But clearly this does not include God {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, who put everything under {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Mais quand [il est] dit : « Toutes choses ont été soumises », [il est] évident que [c’est] à l’exception de celui qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a soumis toutes choses.
fr.B: Or quand l’Écriture dit que toutes choses ont été soumises, il est évident que cela n’inclut pas celui qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a soumis toutes choses.
fr.R: L’Écriture dit que tout a été soumis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Mais il est clair que cela ne comprend pas Dieu {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a tout soumis.

es.L: Pero cuando dice: «Todo ha sido sometido», [es] claro que [esto es] excepto aquel que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sometió todas las cosas.
es.B: Ahora bien, cuando la Escritura dice que todas las cosas han sido puestas en sujeción, es evidente que eso no incluye a aquel que puso todas las cosas en sujeción a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: La Escritura dice que todo ha sido puesto bajo {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. Pero es claro que eso no incluye a Dios mismo, que puso todo bajo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

sw.L: Lakini [Maandiko] yanaposema, "Vitu vyote vimetiishwa," [ni] wazi kwamba [hili] ni isipokuwa yule aliyemtiishia vitu vyote.
sw.B: Basi Maandiko yanaposema kwamba vitu vyote vimetiishwa, ni wazi kwamba hilo halimhusu yule aliyemtiishia vitu vyote.
sw.R: Maandiko yanasema kwamba kila kitu kimewekwa chini ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Lakini ni wazi kwamba hilo halimhusu Mungu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, aliyeweka kila kitu chini {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Nhưng khi [Kinh Thánh] nói: "Mọi sự đã được đặt phục dưới," [thì] rõ ràng là trừ ra Đấng đã đặt mọi sự phục dưới {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi Kinh Thánh nói rằng mọi vật đã được đặt phục dưới, thì rõ ràng là điều đó không gồm Đấng đã đặt mọi vật phục dưới {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Kinh Thánh nói rằng mọi vật đã được đặt dưới quyền {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Nhưng rõ ràng điều đó không gồm chính Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng đã đặt mọi vật dưới quyền {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 "모든 것이 복종하게 되었다"고 말할 때에, 모든 것을 그분께 복종하게 하신 분은 그 가운데 들지 않는 것이 분명합니다.
ko.B: 성경이 모든 것이 복종하게 되었다고 말할 때, 모든 것을 그분께 복종하게 하신 분은 거기에 들지 않는 것이 분명합니다.
ko.R: 성경은 모든 것이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 발아래 놓였다고 말합니다. 그러나 모든 것을 그분 아래 두신 하나님 자신은 분명히 거기에 들어가지 않습니다.

pt.L: Mas, quando [se] diz: "Todas as coisas foram sujeitadas", [é] claro que [isso é] exceto aquele que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} sujeitou todas as coisas.
pt.B: Ora, quando as Escrituras dizem que todas as coisas foram postas em sujeição, é evidente que isso não inclui aquele que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} sujeitou todas as coisas.
pt.R: As Escrituras dizem que tudo foi colocado debaixo {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}. Mas é claro que isso não inclui o próprio Deus, que colocou tudo debaixo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

am.L: ነገር ግን «ሁሉ ተገዝቷል» ሲል፣ ሁሉን ያስገዛለት ሳይጨመር እንደ ሆነ ግልጽ [ነው]።
am.B: ነገር ግን መጽሐፍ ሁሉ ነገር እንደ ተገዛለት ሲናገር፣ ይህ ሁሉን ነገር ያስገዛለትን እንደማይጨምር ግልጽ ነው።
am.R: መጽሐፍ ሁሉ ነገር {{christos:ለክርስቶስ|ለመሲሑ}} እንደ ተገዛ ይናገራል። ነገር ግን ይህ ሁሉን ነገር ያስገዛለትን እግዚአብሔርን ራሱን እንደማይጨምር ግልጽ ነው።

hi.L: पर जब [वह] कहता है, "सब कुछ अधीन कर दिया गया है," तो स्पष्ट है कि जिन्होंने सब कुछ उनके अधीन किया, वे [उसमें] नहीं।
hi.B: पर जब पवित्रशास्त्र कहता है कि सब कुछ अधीन कर दिया गया है, तो स्पष्ट है कि इसमें वे सम्मिलित नहीं जिन्होंने सब कुछ उनके अधीन किया।
hi.R: पवित्रशास्त्र कहता है कि सब कुछ मसीह के अधीन कर दिया गया है। पर स्पष्ट है कि इसमें स्वयं परमेश्वर नहीं आते, जिन्होंने सब कुछ उनके अधीन किया।

ru.L: Когда же сказано: «Всё подчинено», ясно, что кроме Подчинившего {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} всё.
ru.B: Когда же Писание говорит, что всё подчинено, ясно, что это не относится к тому, кто подчинил {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} всё.
ru.R: Писание говорит, что всё подчинено {{christos:Христу|Мессии}}. Но ясно, что это не относится к самому Богу, который всё подчинил {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.

uk.L: А коли каже: «Усе підкорене», то ясно, що крім того, хто підкорив {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} все.
uk.B: А коли Писання каже, що все підкорене, то очевидно, що сюди не входить той, хто підкорив {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} все.
uk.R: Писання каже, що все поставлено під {{christos:Христа|Месію}}. Але ясно, що сюди не входить сам Бог, який поставив усе під {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}.

ja.L: しかし、「すべてのものが従わされた」と言われるとき、すべてのものを[御子に]従わせた方が除かれていることは明らかです。
ja.B: 聖書が、すべてのものが従わされたと言うとき、すべてのものを御子に従わせた方ご自身がそこに含まれていないことは明らかです。
ja.R: 聖書は、すべてのものが{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の下に置かれたと言っています。でも、すべてのものを{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の下に置かれた神ご自身が、その中に含まれていないことは、はっきりしています。

decisions.choice: when it says: when Scripture, God speaking in the Psalm just quoted, says
alternatives: when Christ declares at the end that all things are subjected to him
decisions.reason: The subject of εἴπῃ is not stated. It most naturally refers back to the quotation in verse 27a. Some read ὅταν as "when" in the future, when Christ announces his completed victory.

decisions.choice: apart from the one who subjected: God, who subjects all things to Christ, is not himself among the things subjected
decisions.reason: "The one who subjected" is God and "to him" is Christ. Paul guards against reading "all things" so widely that it includes God.

decisions.choice: Scripture says
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who speaks (m1); Literal keeps the bare verb.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}; God {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}
decisions.reason: Readable names the two persons (m2).

decisions.choice: сам Бог, with no span
decisions.reason: The style guide exempts "сам" from the span.

decisions.choice: "[御子に]" (L), "御子に" (B) for "to him"
decisions.reason: The one to whom all things are subjected is Christ (m2); the title from verse 28 avoids "彼".

source.text: ὅταν δὲ ὑποταγῇ αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα, τότε αὐτὸς ὁ υἱὸς ὑποταγήσεται τῷ ὑποτάξαντι αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα, ἵνα ᾖ ὁ θεὸς πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: when but are subjected to him the all things, then himself the son will be subjected to the [one] having subjected to him the all things, so that may be the God all in all.

en.L: And when all things have been subjected to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, then the Son {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} will be subjected to the one who subjected all things to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, so that God may be all in all.
en.B: And once all things have been made subject to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, the Son {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} will then be made subject to the one who made all things subject to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, so that God may be all in all.
en.R: When everything has been put under the Son, then the Son {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} will put {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} under God, who put everything under {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Then God will be all in all, ruling over everything completely.

fr.L: Et quand toutes choses {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} auront été soumises, alors le Fils {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} sera soumis à celui qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a soumis toutes choses, afin que Dieu soit tout en tous.
fr.B: Et une fois que toutes choses {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} auront été soumises, le Fils {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} sera alors soumis à celui qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a tout soumis, afin que Dieu soit tout en tous.
fr.R: Quand tout aura été soumis au Fils, alors le Fils {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} se soumettra à Dieu, qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a tout soumis. Alors Dieu sera tout en tous : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} régnera pleinement sur tout.

es.L: Y cuando todas las cosas {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} hayan sido sometidas, entonces también el Hijo mismo será sometido al que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sometió todas las cosas, para que Dios sea todo en todos.
es.B: Y una vez que todas las cosas {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} hayan sido sujetadas, entonces el Hijo mismo se sujetará al que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sujetó todas las cosas, para que Dios sea todo en todos.
es.R: Cuando todo haya sido puesto bajo el Hijo, entonces el Hijo mismo se pondrá bajo Dios, que puso todo bajo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Entonces Dios será todo en todos, y reinará por completo sobre todas las cosas.

sw.L: Na vitu vyote vitakapokuwa vimetiishwa chini {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ndipo Mwana {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} atatiishwa chini ya yule aliyemtiishia vitu vyote, ili Mungu awe yote katika yote.
sw.B: Na vitu vyote vikishatiishwa chini {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ndipo Mwana {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} atatiishwa chini ya yule aliyevitiisha vitu vyote chini {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ili Mungu awe yote katika yote.
sw.R: Kila kitu kitakapokuwa kimewekwa chini ya Mwana, ndipo Mwana {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} atajiweka chini ya Mungu, aliyeweka kila kitu chini {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Ndipo Mungu atakuwa yote katika yote, akitawala juu ya kila kitu kikamilifu.

vi.L: Và khi mọi sự đã được đặt phục dưới {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thì chính Con cũng sẽ phục dưới Đấng đã đặt mọi sự phục dưới {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để Đức Chúa Trời là mọi sự trong mọi sự.
vi.B: Và một khi mọi vật đã được đặt phục dưới {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thì chính Con cũng sẽ phục dưới Đấng đã đặt mọi vật phục dưới {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để Đức Chúa Trời là mọi sự trong mọi sự.
vi.R: Khi mọi vật đã được đặt dưới quyền của Con, thì chính Con cũng sẽ tự đặt mình dưới quyền Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng đã đặt mọi vật dưới quyền {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Khi đó, Đức Chúa Trời sẽ là mọi sự trong mọi sự, cai trị trên mọi vật cách trọn vẹn.

ko.L: 모든 것이 그분께 복종하게 될 때에, 아들 자신도 모든 것을 자기에게 복종하게 하신 분께 복종하실 것입니다. 하나님께서 모든 것 안에서 모든 것이 되시게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 모든 것이 아들에게 복종하게 되면, 그때 아들 자신도 모든 것을 자기에게 복종하게 하신 분께 복종하실 것입니다. 그래서 하나님께서 모든 것 안에서 모든 것이 되실 것입니다.
ko.R: 모든 것이 아들 아래 놓이게 되면, 그때 아들 자신도, 모든 것을 그분 아래 두신 하나님 아래에 자신을 두실 것입니다. 그러면 하나님께서 모든 것을 완전히 다스리시며, 모든 것 안에서 모든 것이 되실 것입니다.

pt.L: E, quando todas as coisas {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} tiverem sido sujeitadas, então o próprio Filho será sujeitado àquele que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} sujeitou todas as coisas, para que Deus seja tudo em todos.
pt.B: E, quando todas as coisas {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} tiverem sido submetidas, então o próprio Filho será submetido àquele que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} submeteu todas as coisas, para que Deus seja tudo em todos.
pt.R: Quando tudo tiver sido colocado debaixo do Filho, então o próprio Filho vai se colocar debaixo de Deus, que colocou tudo debaixo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Então Deus será tudo em todos e reinará completamente sobre tudo.

am.L: ሁሉ ከተገዛለት በኋላ ግን፣ በዚያን ጊዜ ወልድ ራሱ ሁሉን ላስገዛለት ይገዛል፤ እግዚአብሔር በሁሉ ሁሉ ይሆን ዘንድ።
am.B: ሁሉ ነገር ከተገዛለት በኋላ፣ ወልድ ራሱ ሁሉን ነገር ላስገዛለት ይገዛል፤ ይኸውም እግዚአብሔር በሁሉ ሁሉ እንዲሆን ነው።
am.R: ሁሉ ነገር ለልጁ ከተገዛ በኋላ፣ ልጁ ራሱ ሁሉን ነገር ላስገዛለት ለእግዚአብሔር ራሱን ያስገዛል። ያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ነገር ፈጽሞ እየገዛ በሁሉ ሁሉ ይሆናል።

hi.L: और जब सब कुछ उनके अधीन हो जाएगा, तब पुत्र स्वयं भी उनके अधीन हो जाएँगे जिन्होंने सब कुछ उनके अधीन किया, ताकि परमेश्वर सब में सब कुछ हों।
hi.B: और जब सब कुछ उनके अधीन कर दिया जाएगा, तब पुत्र स्वयं उनके अधीन हो जाएँगे जिन्होंने सब कुछ उनके अधीन किया, ताकि परमेश्वर सब में सब कुछ हों।
hi.R: जब सब कुछ पुत्र के अधीन कर दिया जाएगा, तब पुत्र स्वयं अपने आप को परमेश्वर के अधीन कर देंगे, जिन्होंने सब कुछ उनके अधीन किया। तब परमेश्वर सब में सब कुछ होंगे, और हर चीज़ पर पूरी तरह राज्य करेंगे।

ru.L: Когда же всё будет подчинено {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}, тогда и сам Сын подчинится Подчинившему {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} всё, чтобы Бог был всё во всём.
ru.B: А когда всё будет подчинено {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}, тогда и сам Сын подчинится тому, кто подчинил {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} всё, чтобы Бог был всё во всём.
ru.R: Когда всё будет подчинено Сыну, тогда и сам Сын подчинит себя Богу, который всё подчинил {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}. Тогда Бог будет всё во всём, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} будет полностью царствовать надо всем.

uk.L: А коли все буде підкорене {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, тоді й сам Син підкориться тому, хто підкорив {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} все, щоб Бог був усім в усьому.
uk.B: І коли все буде підкорене {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, тоді й сам Син підкориться тому, хто підкорив {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} все, щоб Бог був усім в усьому.
uk.R: Коли все буде поставлене під Сина, тоді й сам Син поставить себе під Бога, який поставив усе під {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}. Тоді Бог буде всім в усьому і цілковито правитиме над усім.

ja.L: そして、すべてのものが[御子に]従わされるとき、そのとき御子自身も、すべてのものを自分に従わせた方に従われます。それは、神が、すべてのものの中ですべてであるためです。
ja.B: すべてのものが御子に従わされるとき、御子ご自身も、すべてのものをご自分に従わせてくださった方に従われます。それは、神がすべてを完全に治め、すべてのものの中ですべてとなられるためです。
ja.R: すべてのものが御子の下に置かれるとき、御子ご自身も、すべてのものをご自分の下に置いてくださった神の下に、ご自分を置かれます。そうして、神がすべてのものを完全に治められ、すべてのものの中ですべてとなられるのです。

decisions.choice: to him: Christ; the one who subjected: God
decisions.reason: As in verse 27, "the one who subjected" is God, and the one to whom all things are subjected is Christ, here called "the Son".

decisions.choice: the Son himself will be subjected: when his work is complete, the Son places himself and his kingdom under the Father
decisions.reason: Paul speaks of the Son's place in God's work of saving and ruling, in which the Son does the Father's will (compare 3:23; 11:3; Philippians 2:8-11). He does not say that the Son is a lesser being or that he stops reigning. How this fits with the Son's oneness with the Father has been discussed in the church since early times; the text states the order and does not explain it further.

decisions.choice: will be subjected: the Son's own willing act
alternatives: the Son will be made subject by God
decisions.reason: ὑποταγήσεται is passive in form, matching the other forms of the verb in these verses, and such forms are often used for an act a person does to himself. Nothing in the passage suggests that the Son is made subject against his will.

decisions.choice: all in all: God's rule is complete and unopposed in everything
alternatives: God becomes everything, so that all things are merged into God
decisions.reason: The whole passage is about enemies being defeated and all things being subjected. The phrase describes God's full and unchallenged rule, not the merging of creation into God.

decisions.choice: follow the SBLGNT: "then the Son himself"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "also" before "the Son himself"; others, including some early ones, lack it. The sense hardly changes. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: will put {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} under God
decisions.reason: Readable expresses the Son's willing act (m3).

decisions.choice: ruling over everything completely
decisions.reason: Readable explains "all in all" (m4).

decisions.choice: el Hijo mismo, no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: In "el Hijo mismo" the word "mismo" is an adjective on "Hijo", not a pronoun, so it takes no deity_pronoun span, as "Jesús mismo" in the Gospels; the English "himself" span has no Spanish pronoun to mark. Likewise "Dios mismo" in verse 27.

decisions.choice: se sujetará
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the Spanish middle "se sujetará" for the Son's own willing act (m3); Literal keeps the passive "será sometido".

decisions.choice: "chính Con", with no pronoun span, and "phục dưới" for hypotasso (15:27-28)
decisions.reason: "Chính" is an adjective, not a pronoun, and takes no span, as in the Vietnamese 1 Thessalonians 3:11. "Phục dưới" keeps the picture of the psalm, "under his feet"; Readable makes the Son's act his own (m3), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "복종하다", "복종하게 하다" for the verb of verses 27-28 at every level
decisions.reason: One Korean verb for the Greek verb repeated through these verses, so the reader can follow who subjects and who is subjected; the meaning decision reads the Son's own subjection as his willing act, which the active "복종하시다" (L, B) says.

decisions.choice: o próprio Filho, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English needs "the Son himself", with a span on "himself". Portuguese says the same with "o próprio Filho", where "próprio" is an adjective, not a pronoun, so there is nothing to capitalise. Likewise the reflexive "se" in Readable ("vai se colocar") takes no span.

decisions.choice: ወልድ (the Son) at Literal and Balanced; ልጁ (his Son) at Readable
decisions.reason: Paul uses "the Son" as a title without a name; "ወልድ" is the word Amharic Christians use for the Son of the Father, while "ልጁ" alone would read as an ordinary "his son" in careful prose. Readable, which has just named God, can say "ልጁ" plainly.

decisions.choice: "पुत्र ... हो जाएँगे", honorific
decisions.reason: Paul speaks of the Son, so the Son takes the honorific forms of the narrative (style guide section 4); the plain forms of section 7b are for Jesus speaking of himself.

decisions.choice: сам Сын; себя (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: The English has pronoun spans on "himself". Russian says it with "сам" and "себя", which take no span (style guide 7b).

decisions.choice: сам Син; себе, with no span
decisions.reason: The English puts spans on "himself"; Ukrainian "сам, себе" are exempt by the style guide.

decisions.choice: підкориться
decisions.reason: m3 says it is the Son's own willing act; the Ukrainian reflexive future "підкориться" says that better than a passive.

decisions.choice: "従われます" (L, B); "ご自分を置かれます" (R)
decisions.reason: The Son's own willing act (m3, uncertain, footnoted); the respect form presents it as something he does.

decisions.choice: "御子" at every level
decisions.reason: The Son of the Father in verse 24; "御子" is the usual respectful title.

source.text: Ἐπεὶ τί ποιήσουσιν οἱ βαπτιζόμενοι ὑπὲρ τῶν νεκρῶν;

records.literal_gloss: Otherwise what will they do those being baptized for the dead?

en.L: Otherwise, what will they do, those being baptized on behalf of the dead?
en.B: Otherwise, what will those who are baptized on behalf of the dead accomplish?
en.R: Think about the people who are baptized for the dead. If there is no resurrection, what will they gain by it?

fr.L: Autrement, que feront ceux qui se font baptiser pour les morts ?
fr.B: Autrement, à quoi aboutiront ceux qui se font baptiser en faveur des morts ?
fr.R: Pensez à ceux qui se font baptiser pour les morts. S’il n’y a pas de résurrection, qu’est-ce que cela leur rapportera ?

es.L: De otro modo, ¿qué harán los que se bautizan por los muertos?
es.B: De lo contrario, ¿qué lograrán los que se bautizan en favor de los muertos?
es.R: {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} en los que se bautizan por los muertos. Si no hay resurrección, ¿qué ganan con eso?

sw.L: Vinginevyo, watafanya nini wale wanaobatizwa kwa ajili ya wafu?
sw.B: La sivyo, wale wanaobatizwa kwa ajili ya wafu watapata nini?
sw.R: Fikirini juu ya watu wanaobatizwa kwa ajili ya wafu. Ikiwa hakuna ufufuo, watapata faida gani kwa kufanya hivyo?

vi.L: Bằng không, những người chịu báp-têm vì người chết sẽ làm gì?
vi.B: Nếu không, những người chịu báp-têm vì người chết sẽ được gì?
vi.R: Hãy nghĩ đến những người chịu báp-têm vì người chết. Nếu không có sự sống lại, họ được gì khi làm như vậy?

ko.L: 그렇지 않다면 죽은 사람들을 위하여 세례를 받는 사람들은 무엇을 하겠습니까?
ko.B: 그렇지 않다면 죽은 사람들을 위해 세례를 받는 사람들은 무엇을 얻겠습니까?
ko.R: 죽은 사람들을 위해 세례를 받는 사람들을 생각해 보십시오. 죽은 사람들이 다시 살아나지 않는다면, 그들이 그렇게 해서 무엇을 얻겠습니까?

pt.L: De outro modo, o que farão os que são batizados em favor dos mortos?
pt.B: Do contrário, o que vão conseguir os que são batizados em favor dos mortos?
pt.R: Pensem nas pessoas que são batizadas pelos mortos. Se não existe ressurreição, o que elas vão ganhar com isso?

am.L: አለዚያ ስለ ሙታን የሚጠመቁ ምን ያደርጋሉ?
am.B: አለዚያ ስለ ሙታን የሚጠመቁ ሰዎች በዚህ ምን ሊያከናውኑ ነው?
am.R: ስለ ሙታን የሚጠመቁትን ሰዎች አስቡ። ትንሣኤ ከሌለ በዚህ ምን ይጠቀማሉ?

hi.L: नहीं तो जो मरे हुओं के लिए बपतिस्मा लेते हैं, वे क्या करेंगे?
hi.B: नहीं तो जो मरे हुओं के लिए बपतिस्मा लेते हैं, वे इससे क्या पाएँगे?
hi.R: उन लोगों के बारे में सोचो जो मरे हुओं के लिए बपतिस्मा लेते हैं। अगर पुनरुत्थान है ही नहीं, तो उन्हें इससे क्या मिलेगा?

ru.L: Иначе что будут делать крестящиеся за мёртвых?
ru.B: Иначе чего добьются те, кто крестится за мёртвых?
ru.R: Подумайте о людях, которые крестятся за мёртвых. Если воскресения нет, что они от этого получат?

uk.L: Інакше що робитимуть ті, хто хреститься за мертвих?
uk.B: Інакше чого досягнуть ті, хто хреститься за мертвих?
uk.R: Подумайте про людей, які хрестяться за мертвих. Якщо немає воскресіння, що вони від цього здобудуть?

ja.L: そうでなければ、死者のために洗礼を受ける人たちは、何をすることになるのでしょうか？
ja.B: そうでなければ、死者のために洗礼を受けている人たちは、何を成し遂げることになるのでしょうか？
ja.R: 死んだ人のために洗礼を受ける人たちのことを考えてみてください。もし死んだ人がよみがえらないなら、その人たちは、そうすることで何を得るのでしょうか？

decisions.choice: baptized for the dead: a practice the Corinthians knew; what it was is not known
alternatives: living believers were baptized in place of believers who had died unbaptized
people were baptized for the sake of believing relatives or friends who had died, so as to be united with them at the resurrection
"the dead" are the baptized themselves, whose bodies are dying, or who are baptized with a view to the dead being raised
decisions.reason: Nothing else in the New Testament or in other early writings explains this practice, and many proposals have been made. Paul neither approves nor condemns it. He speaks of "they", not "you" or "we", and uses it only to show that it makes no sense if the dead are not raised. The translation keeps the phrase as open as the Greek.

decisions.choice: for: on behalf of, for the sake of
decisions.reason: ὑπὲρ usually means "on behalf of" or "for the sake of". The other senses have been suggested in order to make the practice easier to explain.

decisions.choice: otherwise: that is, if the dead are not raised
decisions.reason: Ἐπεὶ takes up the argument of verses 12-19 again after verses 20-28.

decisions.choice: If there is no resurrection
decisions.reason: Readable says what "otherwise" stands for (m3).

decisions.choice: por (L, R); en favor de (B)
decisions.reason: The word means on behalf of, for the sake of (m2). What the practice was is not known (m1), so Spanish keeps the open "por" at Literal and Readable and "en favor de" at Balanced, without saying more.

decisions.choice: "chịu báp-têm vì người chết"
decisions.reason: "Vì" can mean on behalf of or for the sake of (m2), and leaves open what the practice was (m1).

decisions.choice: "죽은 사람들을 위하여 세례를 받다" at every level, with no explanation
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the practice is not known; Korean keeps "위하여", which covers "on behalf of" and "for the sake of", and adds nothing.

decisions.choice: ስለ ሙታን (for the dead)
alternatives: በሙታን ፋንታ (in place of the dead)
decisions.reason: "ስለ" is as open as the Greek preposition (for, on behalf of); "በሙታን ፋንታ" would describe the practice more exactly than anyone knows it, and the meaning decision says what it was is not known.

decisions.choice: "死者のために" at every level
decisions.reason: A practice the Corinthians knew but which is not known now (m1, uncertain, footnoted); "ために" leaves open both "on behalf of" and "for the sake of" (m2).

source.text: εἰ ὅλως νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται, τί καὶ βαπτίζονται ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν;

records.literal_gloss: if at all dead not are raised, why also are they baptized for them?

en.L: If [the] dead are not raised at all, why indeed are they baptized on behalf of them?
en.B: If the dead are not raised at all, what is the point of being baptized for them?
en.R: If dead people never rise, why would anyone be baptized for them?

fr.L: Si les morts ne sont absolument pas ressuscités, pourquoi donc se font-ils baptiser pour eux ?
fr.B: Si les morts ne sont pas ressuscités du tout, à quoi bon se faire baptiser pour eux ?
fr.R: Si les morts ne ressuscitent jamais, pourquoi quelqu’un se ferait-il baptiser pour eux ?

es.L: Si los muertos no son resucitados en absoluto, ¿por qué, entonces, se bautizan por ellos?
es.B: Si los muertos no son resucitados de ninguna manera, ¿qué sentido tiene bautizarse por ellos?
es.R: Si los muertos nunca resucitan, ¿por qué alguien se bautizaría por ellos?

sw.L: Ikiwa wafu hawafufuliwi kabisa, kwa nini basi wanabatizwa kwa ajili yao?
sw.B: Ikiwa wafu hawafufuliwi kabisa, kuna maana gani kubatizwa kwa ajili yao?
sw.R: Ikiwa wafu hawafufuki kamwe, kwa nini mtu yeyote abatizwe kwa ajili yao?

vi.L: Nếu người chết hoàn toàn không được sống lại, thì sao họ còn chịu báp-têm vì người chết?
vi.B: Nếu người chết hoàn toàn không được sống lại, thì chịu báp-têm vì họ để làm gì?
vi.R: Nếu người chết không bao giờ sống lại, tại sao người ta lại chịu báp-têm vì họ?

ko.L: 죽은 사람들이 전혀 살아나지 않는다면, 왜 그들을 위하여 세례를 받습니까?
ko.B: 죽은 사람들이 전혀 살아나지 않는다면, 그들을 위해 세례를 받는 것이 무슨 의미가 있겠습니까?
ko.R: 죽은 사람들이 결코 다시 살아나지 않는다면, 왜 누가 그들을 위해 세례를 받겠습니까?

pt.L: Se [os] mortos absolutamente não são ressuscitados, por que também são batizados em favor deles?
pt.B: Se os mortos não são ressuscitados de forma alguma, que sentido tem ser batizado por eles?
pt.R: Se os mortos nunca ressuscitam, por que alguém seria batizado por eles?

am.L: ሙታን ፈጽሞ የማይነሡ ከሆነ፣ ስለ እነርሱ ደግሞ ለምን ይጠመቃሉ?
am.B: ሙታን ፈጽሞ የማይነሡ ከሆነ፣ ስለ እነርሱ መጠመቅ ምን ጥቅም አለው?
am.R: ሙታን ከቶ የማይነሡ ከሆነ፣ ማንም ስለ እነርሱ ለምን ይጠመቃል?

hi.L: यदि मरे हुए जिलाए जाते ही नहीं, तो वे उनके लिए क्यों बपतिस्मा लेते हैं?
hi.B: यदि मरे हुए जिलाए ही नहीं जाते, तो उनके लिए बपतिस्मा लेने का क्या अर्थ है?
hi.R: अगर मरे हुए कभी जी नहीं उठते, तो कोई उनके लिए बपतिस्मा क्यों ले?

ru.L: Если мёртвые вовсе не воскрешаются, зачем и крестятся за них?
ru.B: Если мёртвые вовсе не воскрешаются, какой смысл креститься за них?
ru.R: Если мёртвые никогда не воскресают, зачем кому-то креститься за них?

uk.L: Якщо мертві взагалі не воскрешаються, то навіщо й хрестяться за них?
uk.B: Якщо мертві взагалі не воскрешаються, то який сенс хреститися за них?
uk.R: Якщо мертві ніколи не воскресають, навіщо комусь хреститися за них?

ja.L: もし死者が決して起こされないのなら、なぜ、その人たちは彼らのために洗礼を受けるのでしょうか？
ja.B: 死者がまったくよみがえらされないのなら、その死者たちのために洗礼を受けることに何の意味があるのでしょうか？
ja.R: 死んだ人が決してよみがえらないなら、どうしてその人たちのために洗礼を受けたりするのでしょうか？

decisions.choice: at all: no dead person is ever raised
decisions.reason: ὅλως sharpens the denial Paul is answering (verse 12).

decisions.choice: they ... them: Paul speaks of the practice from outside, without saying he approves of it
decisions.reason: See the note on the previous sentence.

decisions.choice: what is the point
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the force of the question: the practice would be pointless.

source.text: τί καὶ ἡμεῖς κινδυνεύομεν πᾶσαν ὥραν;

records.literal_gloss: why also we are in danger every hour?

en.L: Why also do we face danger every hour?
en.B: And why do we ourselves put our lives at risk hour after hour?
en.R: And why would I and those who work with me put our lives in danger all the time?

fr.L: Pourquoi aussi nous, sommes-nous en danger à toute heure ?
fr.B: Et nous-mêmes, pourquoi mettons-nous notre vie en danger d’heure en heure ?
fr.R: Et pourquoi mes compagnons de travail et moi mettrions-nous notre vie en danger sans arrêt ?

es.L: ¿Y por qué también nosotros estamos en peligro a toda hora?
es.B: ¿Y por qué nosotros mismos arriesgamos la vida hora tras hora?
es.R: ¿Y por qué yo y los que trabajan conmigo pondríamos nuestra vida en peligro todo el tiempo?

sw.L: Kwa nini sisi nasi tuko hatarini kila saa?
sw.B: Na kwa nini sisi wenyewe tunayaweka maisha yetu hatarini saa kwa saa?
sw.R: Na kwa nini mimi na wale wanaofanya kazi pamoja nami tuyaweke maisha yetu hatarini wakati wote?

vi.L: Và sao chúng tôi cũng gặp nguy hiểm từng giờ?
vi.B: Và sao chính chúng tôi lại liều mạng hết giờ này đến giờ khác?
vi.R: Và tại sao tôi và những người cùng làm việc với tôi lại cứ liều mạng sống mình?

ko.L: 또 우리는 왜 매 순간 위험을 무릅씁니까?
ko.B: 또 우리는 왜 언제나 목숨을 걸고 위험 속으로 들어갑니까?
ko.R: 그리고 나와 나와 함께 일하는 사람들이 왜 늘 목숨을 걸고 위험한 일을 하겠습니까?

pt.L: Por que também nós corremos perigo a toda hora?
pt.B: E por que nós mesmos arriscamos a vida hora após hora?
pt.R: E por que eu e os que trabalham comigo poríamos a nossa vida em perigo o tempo todo?

am.L: እኛስ ደግሞ በየሰዓቱ ለምን በአደጋ ውስጥ እንገባለን?
am.B: እኛስ ራሳችን ሰዓት በሰዓት ሕይወታችንን ለአደጋ ለምን እናጋልጣለን?
am.R: እኔና ከእኔ ጋር የሚሠሩትስ ሁልጊዜ ሕይወታችንን ለአደጋ ለምን እናጋልጣለን?

hi.L: और हम भी क्यों हर घड़ी जोखिम उठाते हैं?
hi.B: और हम स्वयं क्यों घड़ी घड़ी अपने प्राणों को जोखिम में डालते हैं?
hi.R: और मैं और मेरे साथ काम करनेवाले क्यों हर समय अपनी जान ख़तरे में डालते हैं?

ru.L: Зачем и мы подвергаемся опасности каждый час?
ru.B: И зачем мы сами час за часом рискуем жизнью?
ru.R: И зачем мне и тем, кто трудится со мной, всё время рисковать жизнью?

uk.L: Навіщо й ми щогодини наражаємося на небезпеку?
uk.B: І навіщо ми самі щогодини ризикуємо своїм життям?
uk.R: І навіщо мені й тим, хто працює зі мною, постійно наражати своє життя на небезпеку?

ja.L: また、なぜ、わたしたちも時々刻々、危険に身をさらしているのでしょうか？
ja.B: また、なぜわたしたち自身も、絶えず命を危険にさらしているのでしょうか？
ja.R: また、どうして、わたしやいっしょに働く仲間たちは、いつも命を危険にさらしているのでしょうか？

decisions.choice: we: Paul and those who preach with him
decisions.reason: ἡμεῖς is emphatic and set against "they" in verse 29. Verses 31-32 go on to Paul's own dangers.

decisions.choice: every hour: all the time
decisions.reason: πᾶσαν ὥραν; means constantly, not hour by hour.

decisions.choice: I and those who work with me
decisions.reason: Readable says who "we" are (m1).

source.text: καθ’ ἡμέραν ἀποθνῄσκω, νὴ τὴν ὑμετέραν καύχησιν, ἣν ἔχω ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Daily I die, by the your boasting, which I have in Christ Jesus the Lord of us.

en.L: Every day I die; [I swear it] by the boasting about you that I have in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus our Lord.
en.B: I die every day. I swear it by how proud I am of you in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus our Lord.
en.R: Every day I am facing death. I promise you this is true, as surely as I am proud of you. And that pride is something I have through {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus our Lord.

fr.L: Chaque jour je meurs ; [je le jure] par ce dont je me vante à votre sujet, [fierté] que j’ai {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus notre Seigneur.
fr.B: Je meurs chaque jour. Je le jure par la fierté que j’ai de vous {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus notre Seigneur.
fr.R: Chaque jour, je risque la mort. Je vous promets que c’est vrai, aussi vrai que je suis fier de vous. Et cette fierté, je l’ai grâce au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus notre Seigneur.

es.L: Cada día muero; [lo juro] por lo mucho que me glorío de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús nuestro Señor.
es.B: Cada día muero. Lo juro por el orgullo que siento por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} nuestro Señor.
es.R: Cada día me enfrento a la muerte. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} prometo que es verdad, tan cierto como que estoy orgulloso de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Y ese orgullo lo tengo gracias a {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} nuestro Señor.

sw.L: Kila siku ninakufa; [naapa] kwa kujivuna kwangu juu yenu, nilio nako katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wetu.
sw.B: Ninakufa kila siku. Naapa hivyo kwa jinsi ninavyowaonea fahari katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wetu.
sw.R: Kila siku ninakabiliwa na kifo. Nawaahidi kwamba hii ni kweli, kama ilivyo kweli kwamba ninawaonea fahari. Na fahari hiyo ninayo kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wetu.

vi.L: Mỗi ngày tôi chết; [tôi thề] bởi niềm khoe mình về anh chị em mà tôi có trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu, Chúa chúng ta.
vi.B: Ngày nào tôi cũng chết. Tôi lấy niềm tự hào của tôi về anh chị em trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Chúa chúng ta, mà thề rằng điều này là thật.
vi.R: Ngày nào tôi cũng đối diện với cái chết. Tôi hứa với anh chị em điều này là thật, chắc chắn như việc tôi tự hào về anh chị em. Và niềm tự hào ấy là điều tôi có nhờ Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Chúa chúng ta.

ko.L: 나는 날마다 죽습니다. 우리 주 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 내가 가진, 여러분에 대한 자랑을 두고 [맹세합니다].
ko.B: 나는 날마다 죽음을 맞습니다. 우리 주 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 내가 여러분을 얼마나 자랑스럽게 여기는지를 두고 맹세합니다.
ko.R: 나는 날마다 죽음을 앞에 두고 삽니다. 내가 여러분을 자랑스럽게 여기는 것이 확실한 만큼, 이 말도 확실합니다. 그리고 내가 여러분을 자랑스럽게 여길 수 있는 것은 우리 주 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 덕분입니다.

pt.L: Cada dia eu morro; [eu juro] pelo motivo de glória que tenho em vocês {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus, nosso Senhor.
pt.B: Eu morro todos os dias. Juro isso pelo orgulho que sinto de vocês {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus, nosso Senhor.
pt.R: Todos os dias eu enfrento a morte. Garanto a vocês que isso é verdade, tão certo quanto tenho orgulho de vocês. E esse orgulho eu tenho por meio {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus, nosso Senhor.

am.L: በየቀኑ እሞታለሁ፤ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ በጌታችን ስለ እናንተ ባለኝ ትምክህት [እምላለሁ]።
am.B: በየቀኑ እሞታለሁ። ይህን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ በጌታችን በእናንተ ምን ያህል እንደምኮራ ምዬ እናገራለሁ።
am.R: በየቀኑ ከሞት ጋር ፊት ለፊት እጋፈጣለሁ። በእናንተ እንደምኮራ እርግጥ እንደ ሆነ ሁሉ ይህም እውነት ነው። ይህን መኩራት ያገኘኩት {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ከጌታችን ነው።

hi.L: मैं हर दिन मरता हूँ; [मैं] तुम्हारे विषय में अपने उस गर्व की [शपथ खाकर कहता हूँ] जो मुझे हमारे प्रभु मसीह यीशु में है।
hi.B: मैं हर दिन मरता हूँ। मैं इसकी शपथ उस गर्व की खाकर कहता हूँ जो मुझे हमारे प्रभु मसीह यीशु में तुम पर है।
hi.R: हर दिन मैं मृत्यु का सामना करता हूँ। मैं तुमसे वादा करता हूँ कि यह सच है, उतना ही सच जितना यह कि मुझे तुम पर गर्व है। और यह गर्व मुझे हमारे प्रभु मसीह यीशु के द्वारा मिला है।

ru.L: Каждый день я умираю, — [клянусь] вашей похвалой, которую я имею {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе, Господе нашем.
ru.B: Я умираю каждый день. Клянусь в этом тем, как я хвалюсь вами {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе, нашем Господе.
ru.R: Каждый день я смотрю в лицо смерти. Я обещаю вам, что это правда, так же верно, как и то, что я горжусь вами. А эта гордость дана мне через {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} Иисуса, нашего Господа.

uk.L: Щодня я вмираю — [клянуся] хвальбою вами, яку маю в {{christos:Христі|Месії}} Ісусі, нашому Господі.
uk.B: Я щодня вмираю. Клянуся тим, як я пишаюся вами в {{christos:Христі|Месії}} Ісусі, нашому Господі.
uk.R: Щодня я дивлюся в очі смерті. Обіцяю вам, що це правда, так само певно, як я пишаюся вами. І цю гордість я маю через {{christos:Христа|Месію}} Ісуса, нашого Господа.

ja.L: 日々、わたしは死んでいます。わたしたちの主{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにあって、わたしがあなたがたについて持っている誇りにかけて[誓います]。
ja.B: わたしは毎日死んでいるのです。わたしたちの主{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにあって、わたしがあなたがたを誇りとしていることにかけて、誓って言います。
ja.R: わたしは毎日、死と向かい合っています。これは本当です。わたしがみなさんのことを誇りに思っているのと同じくらい確かなことです。そして、その誇りは、わたしたちの主{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスを通して、わたしが持っているものなのです。

decisions.choice: I die every day: I face death, my life is constantly at risk
alternatives: I die to myself every day
decisions.reason: The context is danger (verses 30, 32). Paul speaks the same way in 2 Corinthians 4:10-11 and 11:23 ("often near death"). The sense is not spiritual self-denial.

decisions.choice: by my boasting about you: an oath, sworn by Paul's pride in the Corinthians
decisions.reason: νὴ introduces an oath. ὑμετέραν ("your") names the object of the boasting, as Paul's pride in his converts (2 Corinthians 7:4; Philippians 2:16). It is a pride he has "in Christ Jesus", because the Lord did the work (verse 10).

decisions.choice: follow the SBLGNT, without "brothers"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts, some of them early, add "brothers" after "your boasting"; others lack it. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: how proud I am of you (B); I am proud of you (R)
decisions.reason: The book's boasting rule: Literal keeps "boasting"; Balanced and Readable say "proud", since the argument does not turn on the word here.

decisions.choice: I am facing death
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m1).

decisions.choice: ce dont je me vante à votre sujet (L); la fierté que j’ai de vous (B); je suis fier de vous (R)
alternatives: la gloire que je tire de vous (L)
decisions.reason: The book's boasting rule (docs/corinthians-terms.md): Literal keeps the same word throughout so it can be traced, here the "se vanter" family used at Literal in 1:29-31, 5:6 and 9:15-16; Balanced and Readable say "proud" where the argument does not turn on the word. "Se vanter de" can carry Paul's good boasting when the object is good, as here.

decisions.choice: me glorío (L); el orgullo que siento (B); estoy orgulloso (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the boasting family. Literal keeps "gloriarse", as in 1:31 and 5:6; here it is good pride in the Corinthians, so Balanced and Readable say "orgullo", "estar orgulloso", as the English does.

decisions.choice: kujivuna (L); kuwaonea fahari (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice of 1:27: Literal keeps "kujivuna" so the word can be traced; this is Paul's good pride in the Corinthians, so Balanced and Readable say "kuona fahari" (be proud), as the English.

decisions.choice: "자랑" (L); "자랑스럽게 여기다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Paul's good pride in his converts; Balanced and Readable say "자랑스럽게 여기다", as the English says "proud", and Literal keeps "자랑".

decisions.choice: motivo de glória (L); orgulho (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book's boasting rule in Portuguese: Literal keeps the traceable "gloriar-se" / "motivo de glória"; Balanced and Readable say "orgulho", as the English says "proud" here. "Vanglória" is only bad pride, and this is good pride in his converts (m2).

decisions.choice: ትምክህት (boasting) at Literal; መኩራት (being proud) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Following the book-wide choice for boasting: Literal keeps the word that can be traced, "ትምክህት", and Balanced and Readable use "መኩራት", good pride in the Corinthians, as the English says "proud".

decisions.choice: "... की शपथ खाकर कहता हूँ"
decisions.reason: The Greek particle introduces an oath (meaning decision m2); Hindi has no single word for it, so Literal brackets the words of swearing and Balanced says them. "गर्व" as the boasting term.

decisions.choice: пишаюся (B, R)
decisions.reason: The founder's boasting rule: Literal keeps "хвальба"; Balanced and Readable say "proud", since the argument here does not turn on the word.

decisions.choice: "……にかけて[誓います]" (L), "……にかけて、誓って言います" (B)
decisions.reason: An oath sworn by Paul's pride in them (m2); Japanese needs the verb of swearing.

source.text: εἰ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον ἐθηριομάχησα ἐν Ἐφέσῳ, τί μοι τὸ ὄφελος;

records.literal_gloss: if according to human I fought wild beasts in Ephesus, what to me the gain?

en.L: If in human terms I fought wild beasts in Ephesus, what [is] the gain to me?
en.B: If my fight with wild beasts in Ephesus was only for this life's sake, what good has it done me?
en.R: In Ephesus I fought with wild beasts. If I did that only for what this life can give, what good was it to me?

fr.L: Si, humainement parlant, j’ai combattu contre les bêtes sauvages à Éphèse, quel [est] le profit pour moi ?
fr.B: Si mon combat contre les bêtes sauvages à Éphèse n’a été mené que pour cette vie, à quoi m’a-t-il servi ?
fr.R: À Éphèse, j’ai combattu contre des bêtes sauvages. Si je l’ai fait seulement pour ce que cette vie peut donner, à quoi cela m’a-t-il servi ?

es.L: Si, según los hombres, luché contra fieras en Éfeso, ¿qué provecho [hay] para mí?
es.B: Si mi lucha contra las fieras en Éfeso fue solo por las cosas de esta vida, ¿de qué me ha servido?
es.R: En Éfeso luché contra fieras. Si lo hice solo por lo que esta vida puede dar, ¿de qué me sirvió?

sw.L: Ikiwa kwa namna ya kibinadamu nilipigana na wanyama wakali huko Efeso, nina faida gani?
sw.B: Ikiwa vita vyangu na wanyama wakali huko Efeso vilikuwa kwa ajili ya maisha haya tu, vimenifaidia nini?
sw.R: Huko Efeso nilipigana na wanyama wakali. Ikiwa nilifanya hivyo kwa ajili ya kile ambacho maisha haya yanaweza kutoa tu, kilinifaidia nini?

vi.L: Nếu theo [cách] loài người tôi đã đánh nhau với thú dữ tại Ê-phê-sô, thì tôi được ích lợi gì?
vi.B: Nếu cuộc chiến của tôi với thú dữ tại Ê-phê-sô chỉ vì đời này mà thôi, thì tôi được ích lợi gì?
vi.R: Ở Ê-phê-sô tôi đã chiến đấu với thú dữ. Nếu tôi làm vậy chỉ vì những gì đời này đem lại, thì tôi được ích lợi gì?

ko.L: 내가 사람의 방식으로 에베소에서 맹수와 싸웠다면, 나에게 무슨 유익이 있겠습니까?
ko.B: 내가 에베소에서 맹수와 싸운 것이 이 세상의 삶만을 위한 것이었다면, 그것이 나에게 무슨 유익이 되었겠습니까?
ko.R: 나는 에베소에서 맹수와 싸웠습니다. 내가 그 일을 이 세상 삶에서 얻을 것만을 바라고 했다면, 그것이 나에게 무슨 도움이 되었겠습니까?

pt.L: Se em termos humanos lutei com feras em Éfeso, que proveito [há] para mim?
pt.B: Se a minha luta com feras em Éfeso foi só por causa desta vida, de que me serviu?
pt.R: Em Éfeso eu lutei com feras. Se fiz isso só pelo que esta vida pode dar, de que me adiantou?

am.L: በሰው መንገድ በኤፌሶን ከአራዊት ጋር ከታገልኩ፣ ጥቅሙ ለእኔ ምን [ነው]?
am.B: በኤፌሶን ከአራዊት ጋር የታገልኩት ለዚህ ሕይወት ሲባል ብቻ ከሆነ፣ ምን ጠቀመኝ?
am.R: በኤፌሶን ከአራዊት ጋር ታግያለሁ። ይህን ያደረግኩት ይህ ሕይወት ለሚሰጠው ነገር ብቻ ከሆነ፣ ምን ጠቀመኝ?

hi.L: यदि मैं मनुष्य की रीति पर इफिसुस में जंगली पशुओं से लड़ा, तो मुझे क्या लाभ?
hi.B: यदि इफिसुस में जंगली पशुओं से मेरी लड़ाई केवल इसी जीवन के लिए थी, तो उससे मेरा क्या भला हुआ?
hi.R: इफिसुस में मैं जंगली पशुओं से लड़ा। अगर मैंने यह केवल उसके लिए किया जो यह जीवन दे सकता है, तो मुझे उससे क्या लाभ हुआ?

ru.L: Если по-человечески я боролся со зверями в Эфесе, какая мне польза?
ru.B: Если моя борьба со зверями в Эфесе была лишь ради этой жизни, что она мне дала?
ru.R: В Эфесе я боролся с дикими зверями. Если я делал это только ради того, что может дать эта жизнь, какая мне от этого польза?

uk.L: Якщо по-людськи я боровся з дикими звірами в Ефесі, яка мені користь?
uk.B: Якщо моя боротьба з дикими звірами в Ефесі була лише заради цього життя, що вона мені дала?
uk.R: В Ефесі я боровся з дикими звірами. Якщо я робив це лише заради того, що може дати це життя, яка мені з того користь?

ja.L: もし、人間的な[考え]によって、わたしがエフェソで野獣と戦ったのなら、わたしに何の得があるでしょうか？
ja.B: もし、わたしがエフェソで野獣と戦ったのが、この世の望みのためだけだったなら、それがわたしに何の役に立ったでしょうか？
ja.R: わたしはエフェソで、野獣と戦いました。もしそれが、この人生で得られるもののためだけだったなら、わたしにとって何の役に立ったでしょうか？

decisions.choice: fought wild beasts: most likely a picture of fierce human opponents
alternatives: a real fight with animals in the arena
decisions.reason: Paul faced violent opposition in Ephesus (16:9; Acts 19:23-41) and deadly danger in Asia (2 Corinthians 1:8-10). A Roman citizen was not normally sent to the beasts, few survived it, and neither Acts nor Paul's list of sufferings in 2 Corinthians 11:23-27 mentions it. Still, it cannot be ruled out. The translation keeps the picture at every level.

decisions.choice: in human terms: with merely human hopes, for what this life can give
alternatives: humanly speaking, a sign that the words are a figure of speech
decisions.reason: κατὰ ἄνθρωπον can mean either. The sentences around it are about hope limited to this life (verses 19 and 32b), so the first sense fits best.

decisions.choice: only for this life's sake (B); only for what this life can give (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out the sense chosen (m2).

decisions.choice: según los hombres
decisions.reason: The phrase means with merely human hopes (m2). Literal keeps the Greek "according to man" in the usual Spanish form "según los hombres"; Balanced and Readable say "solo por esta vida", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "맹수와 싸우다" at every level, with no explanation
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the words as most likely a picture of fierce human opponents, uncertain and footnoted; every level keeps the picture, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "野獣と戦った" at every level, kept as a picture
decisions.reason: Most likely a picture of fierce human opponents (m1, uncertain, footnoted); Japanese keeps the words and leaves the reading open.

source.text: εἰ νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται, Φάγωμεν καὶ πίωμεν, αὔριον γὰρ ἀποθνῄσκομεν.

records.literal_gloss: if dead not are raised, Let us eat and let us drink, tomorrow for we die.

en.L: If [the] dead are not raised, "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."
en.B: If the dead are not raised, then "Let us eat and drink, since tomorrow we die."
en.R: If the dead do not rise, we might as well say, "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."

fr.L: Si les morts ne sont pas ressuscités, « Mangeons et buvons, car demain nous mourons. »
fr.B: Si les morts ne sont pas ressuscités, alors : « Mangeons et buvons, puisque demain nous allons mourir ! »
fr.R: Si les morts ne ressuscitent pas, autant dire : « Mangeons et buvons, car demain nous mourrons. »

es.L: Si [los] muertos no son resucitados, «comamos y bebamos, porque mañana morimos».
es.B: Si los muertos no son resucitados, entonces «comamos y bebamos, que mañana moriremos».
es.R: Si los muertos no resucitan, sería mejor decir: «Comamos y bebamos, que mañana moriremos».

sw.L: Ikiwa wafu hawafufuliwi, "Na tule na tunywe, kwa maana kesho tunakufa."
sw.B: Ikiwa wafu hawafufuliwi, basi "Tule na tunywe, kwa kuwa kesho tutakufa."
sw.R: Ikiwa wafu hawafufuki, ni afadhali tuseme, "Tule na tunywe, kwa maana kesho tutakufa."

vi.L: Nếu người chết không được sống lại, thì "Chúng ta hãy ăn uống, vì ngày mai chúng ta sẽ chết."
vi.B: Nếu người chết không được sống lại, thì "Hãy ăn uống đi, vì ngày mai chúng ta sẽ chết."
vi.R: Nếu người chết không sống lại, thì chúng ta cũng có thể nói như người ta: "Hãy ăn uống đi, vì ngày mai chúng ta sẽ chết."

ko.L: 죽은 사람들이 살아나지 않는다면 "먹고 마시자. 내일이면 죽을 것이니" [하고 말할 것입니다].
ko.B: 죽은 사람들이 살아나지 않는다면, "먹고 마시자. 내일이면 죽을 테니까" 하고 말하는 것이 낫겠습니다.
ko.R: 죽은 사람들이 다시 살아나지 않는다면, 차라리 "먹고 마시자. 내일이면 죽을 테니까" 하고 말하는 편이 낫겠습니다.

pt.L: Se [os] mortos não são ressuscitados, "Comamos e bebamos, pois amanhã morremos."
pt.B: Se os mortos não são ressuscitados, então "Comamos e bebamos, porque amanhã morremos."
pt.R: Se os mortos não ressuscitam, então é melhor dizer: "Vamos comer e beber, porque amanhã vamos morrer."

am.L: ሙታን የማይነሡ ከሆነ፣ «እንብላ፣ እንጠጣም፤ ነገ እንሞታለንና።»
am.B: ሙታን የማይነሡ ከሆነ፣ «ነገ ስለምንሞት እንብላ፣ እንጠጣ።»
am.R: ሙታን የማይነሡ ከሆነ፣ እንዲህ ብንል ይሻላል፦ «ነገ ስለምንሞት እንብላ፣ እንጠጣ።»

hi.L: यदि मरे हुए नहीं जिलाए जाते, तो "आओ, हम खाएँ और पिएँ, क्योंकि कल हम मरते हैं।"
hi.B: यदि मरे हुए नहीं जिलाए जाते, तो "आओ, खाएँ-पिएँ, क्योंकि कल तो मरना ही है।"
hi.R: अगर मरे हुए जी नहीं उठते, तो हम यह भी कह सकते हैं, "आओ, खाएँ-पिएँ, क्योंकि कल तो हमें मरना ही है।"

ru.L: Если мёртвые не воскрешаются, «Будем есть и пить, ведь завтра умрём.»
ru.B: Если мёртвые не воскрешаются, то «будем есть и пить, раз завтра умрём.»
ru.R: Если мёртвые не воскресают, можно с тем же успехом сказать: «Давайте есть и пить, ведь завтра мы умрём.»

uk.L: Якщо мертві не воскрешаються, «Їжмо й пиймо, бо завтра помремо».
uk.B: Якщо мертві не воскрешаються, то «їжмо й пиймо, бо завтра помираємо».
uk.R: Якщо мертві не воскресають, то можна й сказати: «Їжмо й пиймо, бо завтра помремо».

ja.L: もし死者が起こされないなら、「食べたり飲んだりしよう。明日は死ぬのだから」[ということになります]。
ja.B: もし死者がよみがえらされないのなら、「食べたり飲んだりしよう。どうせ明日は死ぬのだから」ということになります。
ja.R: もし死んだ人がよみがえらないなら、「食べたり飲んだりしよう。明日は死ぬのだから」と言ったほうがましです。

decisions.choice: Isaiah 22:13
decisions.reason: The words match the Greek Old Testament of Isaiah 22:13 exactly. There the people of Jerusalem feast when they should be mourning and turning back to God. Paul uses the words for the outlook of people who expect nothing after death.

decisions.choice: we die: a present tense for what is about to happen
decisions.reason: ἀποθνῄσκομεν is present in form; death is near and certain.

decisions.choice: we might as well say
decisions.reason: Readable shows that this is the conclusion someone without hope would draw.

decisions.choice: the words of Isaiah 22:13 in the plain style ("먹고 마시자")
decisions.reason: A quotation of Scripture and of a careless people's slogan takes the plain style.

source.text: μὴ πλανᾶσθε· φθείρουσιν ἤθη χρηστὰ ὁμιλίαι κακαί.

records.literal_gloss: not be deceived; ruin morals good companies bad.

en.L: Do not be led astray: "Bad associations ruin good morals."
en.B: Make no mistake: "Good character is ruined by bad company."
en.R: Do not fool yourselves. As the saying goes, "If you spend time with bad people, they will spoil your good ways."

fr.L: Ne vous laissez pas égarer : « Les mauvaises fréquentations ruinent les bonnes mœurs. »
fr.B: Ne vous y trompez pas : « La mauvaise compagnie gâte le bon caractère. »
fr.R: Ne vous faites pas d’illusions. Comme dit le proverbe : « Si tu passes ton temps avec des gens mauvais, ils abîmeront ce qu’il y a de bon en toi. »

es.L: No {{plural_you:se dejen|os dejéis}} engañar: «Las malas compañías corrompen las buenas costumbres».
es.B: No {{plural_you:se engañen|os engañéis}}: «Las malas compañías echan a perder el buen carácter».
es.R: No {{plural_you:se engañen|os engañéis}}. Como dice el refrán: «Si andas con gente mala, echarás a perder tus buenas costumbres».

sw.L: Msipotoshwe: "Ushirika mbaya huharibu maadili mema."
sw.B: Msijidanganye: "Tabia njema huharibiwa na marafiki wabaya."
sw.R: Msijidanganye. Kama msemo unavyosema, "Ukikaa na watu wabaya, watakuharibia tabia yako njema."

vi.L: Đừng bị lừa dối: "Bạn bè xấu làm hư thói nết tốt."
vi.B: Đừng để mình bị lừa: "Bạn bè xấu làm hỏng tính nết tốt."
vi.R: Đừng tự lừa dối mình. Như câu tục ngữ nói: "Nếu giao du với người xấu, họ sẽ làm hư những thói quen tốt của bạn."

ko.L: 속지 마십시오. "나쁜 친구들은 좋은 습관을 망친다."
ko.B: 잘못 생각하지 마십시오. "나쁜 사람들과 어울리면 좋은 성품이 망가진다."
ko.R: 스스로 속지 마십시오. 이런 말이 있습니다. "나쁜 사람들과 어울려 다니면 그들이 너의 좋은 습관을 망쳐 놓는다."

pt.L: Não se deixem enganar: "Más companhias corrompem bons costumes."
pt.B: Não se enganem: "O bom caráter é estragado pelas más companhias."
pt.R: Não enganem a si mesmos. Como diz o ditado: "Quem anda com gente ruim acaba estragando os seus bons costumes."

am.L: አትሳቱ፤ «ክፉ ባልንጀርነት መልካሙን ጠባይ ያበላሻል።»
am.B: አትታለሉ፤ «መጥፎ ጓደኝነት መልካም ጠባይን ያበላሻል።»
am.R: ራሳችሁን አታታልሉ። አንድ አባባል እንዲህ ይላል፦ «ከመጥፎ ሰዎች ጋር ጊዜህን ብታሳልፍ መልካሙን ጠባይህን ያበላሹብሃል።»

hi.L: धोखा न खाओ: "बुरी संगतें भले आचरण को नष्ट करती हैं।"
hi.B: भूल में न रहो: "बुरे साथी अच्छे चाल-चलन को बिगाड़ देते हैं।"
hi.R: अपने आप को धोखा मत दो। कहावत है, "अगर तुम बुरे लोगों के साथ समय बिताओगे, तो वे तुम्हारी अच्छी आदतें बिगाड़ देंगे।"

ru.L: Не обманывайтесь: «Дурное общество губит добрые нравы.»
ru.B: Не заблуждайтесь: «Плохая компания портит хороший характер.»
ru.R: Не обманывайте самих себя. Как говорится, «Кто проводит время с плохими людьми, у того портятся хорошие привычки.»

uk.L: Не обманюйтеся: «Погане товариство псує добрі звичаї».
uk.B: Не помиляйтеся: «Добрий характер псується від поганої компанії».
uk.R: Не обманюйте самих себе. Як кажуть: «Якщо проводиш час із поганими людьми, вони зіпсують твої добрі звички».

ja.L: 惑わされてはいけません。「悪い付き合いは良い品性を損なう。」
ja.B: 思い違いをしてはいけません。「良い品性も、悪い仲間によって損なわれる。」
ja.R: 自分をだましてはいけません。ことわざにも、「悪い人たちといっしょにいると、自分の良い生き方もだめになる」とあります。

decisions.choice: a well-known Greek saying, a line from the poet Menander
decisions.reason: The line comes from the comedy Thais by the Athenian poet Menander (fourth to third century BC) and had become a common saying. Paul quotes it as a proverb; it does not show that he had read Menander.

decisions.choice: company: the people one spends time and talks with
decisions.reason: ὁμιλίαι can mean both. In context the bad company is those who say there is no resurrection (verses 12, 34), whose outlook leads to the life of verse 32.

decisions.choice: do not be led astray: stop letting yourselves be deceived
decisions.reason: μὴ πλανᾶσθε is a present command, as in 6:9: they are already in danger of being misled.

decisions.choice: Make no mistake
decisions.reason: As in 6:9.

decisions.choice: As the saying goes
decisions.reason: Readable shows that this is a well-known saying (m1).

decisions.choice: tu, toi in the saying (R)
decisions.reason: A French proverb speaks to anyone in the singular; the readers themselves are addressed as "vous" in the same sentence.

decisions.choice: the Greek saying in the plain style of a proverb
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says Paul quotes a common Greek saying as a proverb; Korean gives it in the plain style a proverb takes.

decisions.choice: the saying in the singular አንተ (ጊዜህን, ጠባይህን)
decisions.reason: A proverb in Amharic speaks to one listener; the quoted saying is general, and the singular makes it sound like a saying rather than Paul's own command.

decisions.choice: «Дурное общество губит добрые нравы» (L) and the like
decisions.reason: A line from Menander that Paul quotes as a proverb (meaning decision m1). The Synodal form has become a Russian saying, but its words are old; Russian says it afresh at each level.

source.text: ἐκνήψατε δικαίως καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε, ἀγνωσίαν γὰρ θεοῦ τινες ἔχουσιν· πρὸς ἐντροπὴν ὑμῖν λαλῶ.

records.literal_gloss: Sober up rightly and not sin, ignorance for of God some have; toward shame to you I speak.

en.L: Sober up properly and stop sinning, for some have ignorance of God; I speak to your shame.
en.B: Sober up, as you should, and stop sinning. There are some who do not know God at all. I say this to shame you.
en.R: Come to your senses, as you should, and stop sinning. Some of you do not really know God. I am saying this to make you ashamed.

fr.L: Dégrisez-vous comme il faut et cessez de pécher, car certains ont l’ignorance de Dieu ; je [le] dis à votre honte.
fr.B: Dégrisez-vous, comme il se doit, et cessez de pécher. Il y en a qui ne connaissent pas du tout Dieu. Je le dis pour vous faire honte.
fr.R: Revenez à la raison, comme vous le devez, et arrêtez de pécher. Certains d’entre vous ne connaissent pas vraiment Dieu. Je dis cela pour que vous ayez honte.

es.L: {{plural_you:Despierten|Despertad}} como es debido y no {{plural_you:pequen|pequéis}}, porque algunos tienen ignorancia de Dios; para vergüenza {{plural_you:de ustedes|vuestra}} [lo] digo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a la sobriedad, como es debido, y {{plural_you:dejen|dejad}} de pecar. Hay algunos que no conocen a Dios en absoluto. Lo digo para {{plural_you:avergonzarlos|avergonzaros}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cabales, como es debido, y {{plural_you:dejen|dejad}} de pecar. Algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no conocen de verdad a Dios. Digo esto para que {{plural_you:sientan|sintáis}} vergüenza.

sw.L: Levukeni ipasavyo, wala msiendelee kutenda dhambi, kwa maana wengine hawamjui Mungu; nasema [hivi] kwa aibu yenu.
sw.B: Levukeni, kama inavyowapasa, mkaache kutenda dhambi. Kuna baadhi ambao hawamjui Mungu hata kidogo. Nasema hivi ili kuwatia aibu.
sw.R: Rudini kwenye akili zenu, kama inavyowapasa, na mwache kutenda dhambi. Baadhi yenu hammjui Mungu kweli. Ninasema hivi ili mwone aibu.

vi.L: Hãy tỉnh táo lại cho đúng đắn và đừng phạm tội nữa, vì có một số người không biết Đức Chúa Trời; tôi nói điều này để anh chị em xấu hổ.
vi.B: Hãy tỉnh táo lại như anh chị em phải tỉnh táo, và đừng phạm tội nữa. Có một số người hoàn toàn không biết Đức Chúa Trời. Tôi nói điều này để anh chị em phải xấu hổ.
